subject: Scammers take advantage of natural disasters.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Truth to Power PAC
body:
Here's how to protect yourself
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39387%2E3422442%2EtGtW4L)
Derek,
As a consumer protection advocate, I’ve seen the egregious ways scammers take advantage of natural disasters. As victims who lost homes navigate insurance payouts and charity or government assistance, scammers sometimes pose as these organizations in an attempt to get your banking or personal information.
If you’re a fire victim, be sure to do your research before handing over any personal information, and [check out this article for more tips.](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21342?t=2&akid=39387%2E3422442%2EtGtW4L)
**Scammers also take advantage of those of us who want to help during a natural disaster, posing as a charity or family in need.** It’s a disgusting way to make a buck.
When deciding where to donate, my suggestion is to always do a bit of research on the charity you’re giving to. While there are lots of grifters out there, there are also lots of dedicated journalists who have written about the many organizations on the ground in LA right now who could use your support. [Here’s one of those articles.](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21339?t=3&akid=39387%2E3422442%2EtGtW4L)
One of the organizations doing critical work right now is the **[California Fire Foundation](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20250113-wildfires?refcode=em20250113-39387&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39387_3422442_tGtW4L&akid=39387%2E3422442%2EtGtW4L)**. The California Fire Foundation is operated by California Professional Firefighters, the union which represents 35,000 firefighters and emergency medical service personnel across the state.
The California Fire Foundation supports:
1) **Firefighters** , by helping families of firefighters who are killed or injured in the line of duty.
2) **Fire victims** , by distributing $250 gift cards to eligible survivors who need assistance getting things like food and clothing.
**[If you are safe and able to do so, please join me in making a charitable donation to the California Fire Foundation to support the brave firefighters on the frontlines, and the LA community.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20250113-wildfires?refcode=em20250113-39387&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39387_3422442_tGtW4L&akid=39387%2E3422442%2EtGtW4L)**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20250113-wildfires?refcode=em20250113-39387&refcode2=39387_3422442_tGtW4L&akid=39387%2E3422442%2EtGtW4L)
I am praying for my neighbors in Los Angeles and so thankful for all of the hard work of the first responders who are on the frontlines.
With gratitude,
Katie Porter

#### For the past two years, I’ve dedicated myself to the fight against Ranked Choice Voting (RCV), working tirelessly to protect the integrity of our election systems. Together with incredible grassroots support, we’ve made remarkable progress: helping six states prevent the adoption of RCV, debating three Alaska legislators, three Oregon legislators, the father of RCV in Oakland and San Francisco, and even Presidential Candidate for the Libertarian Party Chase Oliver.
#### Despite being outspent 100 to 1 by out-of-state interests pouring $15 million into defending RCV, we stood strong, losing by only a fraction of a percent after two weeks of counting. We fought not only in the court of public opinion but also in Alaska’s legal system, where we successfully defended our ballot measure with unanimous victories in both the Alaska Superior Court and the Alaska Supreme Court.
#### Though we fell just short this time, I firmly believe RCV is on life support. Momentum is building across the nation, and I’m already offering my support to efforts in Maine and here at home in Alaska to continue this important work. This isn’t the end—it’s another step in the fight to ensure fair, transparent elections for all. Thank you for standing with me in this journey; together, we’ll keep moving forward.
#### With the formation of a new group dedicated to repealing Ranked Choice Voting (RCV), I have made the difficult decision to withdraw my application. I believe it’s important to avoid duplicating efforts and the potential confusion of having two repeal measures on the ballot simultaneously. My hope is that this new group can achieve their goal—it’s not an easy task, but I fully support their mission and wish them success in this important endeavor.
#### I will finish my two new petitions soon and I look forward to having everyone’s help on those.
---
|
---
#### The money used to bring Ranked Choice Voting and keep RCV, Increase Minimum Wage, Automatic Voter Registration, Campaign Finance Law changes, etc is coming from Hansjorg Wyss, a Swiss national, not a U.S. Citizen.
#### **Arabella** **Advisors** / 1630 Fund, they push Ranked Choice Voting, Decriminalizing of hard drugs in Oregon, Anti-2A legislation, Minimum Wage Increase, Redistricting, Abortion, and more. We are dealing with a very sophisticated organization with no direct counter on the Right.
#### How do we defeat 500+ nonprofits and over $1.6 Billion a year in donations, more than the RNC and DNC combined?

I published [an article yesterday](https://substack.com/redirect/a1f28e5a-55c0-474d-aff6-c91f4cff35f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) reflecting on crises including the wildfires across Los Angeles. That post reflected on the unique international identity of Los Angeles, and the sad irony of cities on both coasts of the United States suffering climate disasters while Congress continues to sit on its hands, deferring to a predatory fossil fuel industry that will make future climate fueled disasters only worse and more frequent.
This post will look beyond Congress, particularly at socioeconomic dimensions of the wildfires and some impacts that will continue to be felt long after the fires are finally extinguished.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/19511abb-cc3d-443a-8b41-fb41920b53d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: peoplesdispatch.org
### **We 're all in this together**
The state of American politics might suggest that some (or, more accurately, a great many) wealthy Americans think that their wealth can insulate them from the worst impacts of the climate crisis.
The particular voters who have kept corporate Democrats and fascist Republicans in office have made choices to privilege their bank accounts above Climate Justice.
None loom larger than the world's richest man, Elon Musk. He not only invested hundreds of millions of dollars in Trump's ([potentially illegitimate](https://substack.com/redirect/c019372f-23ca-4e0d-ad3a-c007b44ddc1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) victory, but has long envisioned humanity pursuing his vain dream of colonizing Mars.
_Thanks for reading Chronicles of a Dying Empire! You can help inform your friends by sharing this post._
[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=154761807&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTU0NzYxODA3LCJpYXQiOjE3MzY4MTYwMzEsImV4cCI6MTczOTQwODAzMSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.PlNG_x2ftNhk6Q2l1Ovp23AlH8pXA_m_7_Zkw_21iMc)
It would not be unfair to say that Mr. Musk is willing to sacrifice millions of human lives in the service of his own personal aggrandizement. Every mass murderer in human history has pursued more limited, less devious ambitions.
Beyond Musk, any number of other figures have chosen any number of other ways to put their personal fortune before values including sustainability or the survivability of the future for their children and grandchildren.
### **Intergenerational irony**
The profound idiocy embodied by Washington is exposed by indigenous perspectives of intergenerational solidarity and accountability. In some indigenous communities, communities are [invited](https://substack.com/redirect/0131ff42-37e7-4094-886a-f80bdc299680?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to consider the impacts of their decisions today across the next seven generations. This perspective stands in sharp and dramatic contrast from a civilization most concerned with the opulence of its most thankless and least praiseworthy figures.
There is a great deal of poetic justice in the suffering endured by America in the present, given our country's abject refusal to consider the needs of the future at any point in the recent past.
At least three further ironies emerge when examining this disaster and its impacts that will continue to be felt across the region for decades.
### **Neighborhoods doomed by decisions made elsewhere**
Like most of California, Pacific Palisades voted by large margins for Democrats, [including](https://substack.com/redirect/3aa13a45-8f21-4d23-be6a-72d63aa48f28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the most recent presidential election.
The failures of corporate Democrats to prioritize climate justice place them in the disturbing role of betraying their own base. It should be no surprise to anyone that the Democratic Party's leaders are more [concerned about their own careers](https://substack.com/redirect/1cacac1b-6ac9-43d7-aba1-ea35ec74bdb9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) than anyone else, or the future we all share.
But the idea of allowing conditions to fester that will eventually kill the party's own supporters takes the notion of oblivious political narcissism to a whole new level.
Ultimately, the neighborhoods in Los Angeles that burned to the ground over the last week were doomed by people who live in other neighborhoods in DC, Maryland, and Virginia, where politicians and their aides made conscious--and continuing--decisions to ignore decades of warnings.

### **Wealth won 't save you**
Beyond Elon Musk, many Americans who enjoy wealth imagine that their resources can offer them some sort of respite from the mounting global climate catastrophe. This week reveals the futility of that pretense.
One wealthy real estate investor who posted a [plea on social media](https://substack.com/redirect/e1d045fe-0f12-4d50-9081-6fa39f005f74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for private firefighters to save his home--after having previously bragged about not paying taxes--was dragged so mercilessly by the Twitterverse that he ultimately [deleted his account](https://substack.com/redirect/f6565346-5317-4904-862a-6201f54bc001?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
The market for underground bunkers has found a steady stream of buyers eager to exempt themselves from the problems that decades of ignorant social policy have invited. For instance, [Atlas Survival Bunkers](https://substack.com/redirect/b1cd1af7-f28a-40ef-b612-d4c61fc3c9ea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) claims to be the world's number one supplier of bunkers. Based in Texas, the company offers:
> a wide range of survival shelters designed to safeguard you and your family in the event of a pandemic outbreak, civil unrest, malicious mobs, and threats such as biological, nuclear fallout, or EMP attacks originating from either domestic or international sources.
The company's precast concrete options start at $20,000, and many of their other models are undoubtedly more expensive. Every one of their customers, it seems, is willing to throw away tens of thousands of dollars in a futile hope to save themselves from calamities that can only be addressed collectively.
So-called climate preppers imagine that their individual actions can provide a pathway to sustainability. Entire bodies of fiction have been dedicated to this premise, like the _[Fallout](https://substack.com/redirect/3ba0e495-1718-4a17-a3b1-956ad60610e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ series of games and movies. If I manage to find enough time away from work to write another post this week, I hope to focus it on the prescience of Octavia Butler's _Parable of the Sower_.
But wealth offers no insulation from the climate crisis. The fate of Pacific Palisades should make that painfully and inescapably clear.
Before the wildfires burned the neighborhood to the ground, the median listing price of a home in Pacific Palisades was [$4.7 million](https://substack.com/redirect/baea658f-7abb-4d29-9bb8-21571605f635?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). An entire neighborhood of some of the richest people in the second largest city of the world's richest country just went up in flames.
If that doesn't offer a wake up call to wealthy Americans in other cities to finally start prioritizing the needs of the future over their own bank accounts, nothing likely ever will.
### **Housing**
Meanwhile, the state of California continues to struggle with a housing shortage made only worse by the recent and ongoing calamity.
California was grappling with a profound [housing shortage](https://substack.com/redirect/64c515a4-7bf0-4ae9-a62b-61fe37080b87?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) even before the ongoing fires burned tens of thousands of homes to the ground and reduced entire neighborhoods to rubble.
Our state includes the largest homeless population of any state in the country, [driven largely by evictions](https://substack.com/redirect/946e372b-cfcf-4ba8-8d33-4c1877b78ee2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of long-time residents unable to compete with other renters and buyers in housing markets that ultimately serve the interest of property developers, more than working families or people who need shelter.
Millions of other Californians who do have homes remain precarious. According to a recent report by the Public Policy Institute of California, "[one in six](https://substack.com/redirect/64c515a4-7bf0-4ae9-a62b-61fe37080b87?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) middle-class renters in California are now spending over half their income on housing."
Because our system treats housing like an opportunity for private investment, rather than a human right, we have remained entirely reliant on private developers to build the housing stock needed by the state's diverse workforce and our families.
This moment reveals the inadequacy of that approach, as well. To the extent the profit motive constrained the ability to mobilize resources to house the state's residents even before the wildfire, things just got immeasurably worse. Hundreds of thousands of Southern California residents have been displaced, and at least tens of thousands of them have lost their homes entirely and will be unable to return to them.
Where do leaders in either Washington or Sacramento envision them going when the fires subside and the smoke clears?
Countries with robust public housing models are more resilient in the face of these climate disasters. We could learn from their examples, or instead continue making stupid decisions that make predictable--and preventable--problems immeasurably worse.

name: Andrew Yang
subject: Talking Good
body:
I get asked all of the time about what it was like running for President. Running for President was in many ways a communications challenge. | |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=4c5a5a9e3f&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
---
| Hello, I hope ’25 is off and running for you!

I get asked all of the time about what it was like running for President. Running for President was in many ways a communications challenge. You have a vision you want to present to people. But it’s also competitive in that there are others – lifelong politicians – who want airtime and you have to try to break through.

This week on the [podcast](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=d099def225&e=0f227c2ae3) I interview Michael Chad Hoeppner, the author of the new book “Don’t Say Um: How to Communicate Effectively to Live a Better Life.” Michael was the expert, then a communications professor at Columbia Business School, my campaign brought in to coach me prior to the 2nd primary debate. You might recognize him as the “Terence” character in [The Last Election](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=90ab2cc1b9&e=0f227c2ae3).

“People think of communication as something you either are good at or you’re not. But it’s something that virtually anyone can get better at if they put in the time and practice in the right way,” Michael observes. “Communication is a physical act and something that responds to training.” Michael was a Broadway performer earlier in his career, which is very physical.

Michael’s approach clicked for me because he homed in on how I was speaking as a performance activity. For example, he identified immediately that I had a tendency to cram too many words per minute into some of my answers. A slower pace would lead to more pauses and emphasis and a stronger delivery. Michael changed the timer in my head so I felt that I didn’t have to rush through a number of drills and exercises.

His book takes the same approach with different aspects of communication, like vocal variety: Pace, Pause, Power, Pitch and Placement. He also writes about optimizing your posture, gestures and nervous energy. My team got used to my reciting “Topeka bodega, topeka bodega” as a warm-up prior to a televised interview. I would sometimes jump up and down or jog in place backstage before a debate to get my blood pumping.
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=ea405bc904&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
| I said to Michael on the trail, “You should write a book.” And now here we are. One thing I love about Michael is he’s totally pragmatic. “The title of the book is a trick; we get negative directions all of the time, like ‘don’t be nervous.’ That stuff doesn’t work. Thought suppression doesn’t work, like ‘don’t think of a pink elephant.’ The question really is how do we develop the muscle memory to do all of the things we want to do in a communications setting without thinking about them. My goal for the book is to have people be aware of their top 1 to 3 communications practices they can improve on and then actually implement them in real life.”

Michael is passionate about helping people communicate better. He’s acutely aware of the era we are in. “With technology getting more and more powerful, it’s more important than ever that we have positive humans who are effective communicators with good intentions.” As he writes in his book, “We need honorable, moral communicators!” I couldn’t agree more, whether it’s advancing in one’s career, running for office or just living a better life expressing your thoughts to those around you.

For my podcast interview with Michael, click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=0e812703ee&e=0f227c2ae3). For his book, including a free chapter, click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=cc333bc321&e=0f227c2ae3). It’s also my birthday today – if you want to help me celebrate do something positive for someone in your life!
---
| **
Andrew Yang**
Co-Chair, Forward Party
[forwardparty.com](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=ddeb3c13c9&e=0f227c2ae3)

body:

The trial of my life begins this week. And I don’t get a jury!
| [](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z32ql6evn678911klfe2j3rv7lt8hhue7iktb32g_rp22sh2s8i6epj3c3im0or0c3h2bs)
---
Friend,
---
With the trial of my life set to begin, President Donald J. Trump just said two powerful words for the entire nation to hear...
---
**_“SAVE RUDY!”_**
---
On Thursday, I will be on trial – __without_ a jury, mind you_ – to determine whether or not I still have a home to live in. It’s a trial to save my home and a trial to fight for my basic freedoms and rights.
---
_But more than that, our nation’s very system of justice will also be on trial._
---
If the Radical Left Democrats can get away with destroying me in a weaponized court without a jury – and possibly imprisoning me – solely because I served as President Trump’s lawyer, then the rule of law is DEAD in America.
---
**Just last week, a bloodthirsty left-wing judge threatened me with contempt and imprisonment if I didn’t recite her dictated false version of covered-up massive evidence of voter fraud.**
---
I had a choice to make: _I could recite the state-sanctioned propaganda like an obedient little dog and be rewarded with a pat on the head. Or, I could have the courage to stand for what I know to be true._
---
When I remind you of this Bible verse, you’ll know exactly which choice I made: "_For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?_ " (Mark 8:36)
---
You see, I refuse to give up on America. That’s why I’m going on trial to fight to save my home, my liberty, and __our__ Republic.
---
_Are YOU with me?_ Will you join the cause to “SAVE RUDY?”
---

---
| Dear Hello
Today the Senate will hear several controversial bills in committee or subcommittee. It's up to you to call in and express your opinion to legislators, which you can do in real time tomorrow via Zoom.
Please consider calling into the committee when they are meeting to express whether you support or oppose a bill. Remember. You can do this while the committee or subcommittee is meeting live.
Want more information on the Virginia Retirement System, the proposed budget for the Department of Taxation, an update from the Department of Elections on the VERIS System or get an update on the Governor's proposed budget for general government?
Then tune in at 7:30am for the Senate Finance and Appropriations' Subcommittee on General Government and watch these presentations from home.
Watch Republican Senator Bill Stanley present his bills regarding animal testing and pet shop regulations at 8am in the Subcommittee on Companion Animals.
Tomorrow, new legislators should be sworn in. You can watch that live. Otherwise, not much is going on during the regular Senate session. There are several bills that have passed out of committee but they are on the uncontested calendar, meaning unanimous consent from all Republicans and Democrats sitting on that particular committee. Any senator can pull a bill out of the uncontested block and ask that the bill be heard by the full senate.
15 minutes after session, there will be a couple of bills before the Senate Privileges & Elections Committee that you will want to call in on.
SJ247 is a Constitutional Amendment for the fundamental right to reproductive freedom by Democrat Senator Boysko. Please call in to oppose.
SJ249 is another Constitutional Amendment for the repeal of same sex marriage by Democrat Senator Ebbin. Please call to oppose this bill.
30 minutes after session, please tune into the Senate Committee on Agriculture, Conservation and Natural Resources.
Please call in to support Republican Senator Richard Stuart's bill SB806 to repeal the State Air Pollution Control Board's authority to implement low-emissions and zero-emissions vehicle standards that apply for vehicles with a model year of 2025 later.
If you remember, this was a bill the Democrats passed that links our car emissions requirements to that of California. Please click on the links above to call in to the committee to oppose this authoritarian bill.
Concerned about the rising cost of healthcare? Republican Senator Bill Stanley will be presenting SB910 at 4pm. This bill attempts to repeal the certificate of public need requirements for many categories of medical care facilities and projects. Please call in to the committee and express support for this good free market bill.
Did you know that you can watch your Virginia General Assembly in action every Monday through Friday until they adjourn on Saturday, February 22?
Just click the links below to watch a committee meeting or session.
You can actually call in while the committee is meeting and state whether you support or oppose each of the bills on the docket and briefly explain your position.
Some people prefer to go in person.
Due to the thousands of bills that will come before the House and the Senate, I will be following the Senate calendar. If a bill passes the House, it will be reviewed by the Senate after crossover.
If you would like to tune to committee meetings or session, you can do so using the links below. If you missed the meetings, you can always watch the recordings.

The trial of my life begins this week. And I don’t get a jury!

---
Friend,
---
With the trial of my life set to begin, President Donald J. Trump just said two powerful words for the entire nation to hear...
---
**_“SAVE RUDY!”_**
---
On Thursday, I will be on trial – __without_ a jury, mind you_ – to determine whether or not I still have a home to live in. It’s a trial to save my home and a trial to fight for my basic freedoms and rights.
---
_But more than that, our nation’s very system of justice will also be on trial._
---
If the Radical Left Democrats can get away with destroying me in a weaponized court without a jury – and possibly imprisoning me – solely because I served as President Trump’s lawyer, then the rule of law is DEAD in America.
---
**Just last week, a bloodthirsty left-wing judge threatened me with contempt and imprisonment if I didn’t recite her dictated false version of covered-up massive evidence of voter fraud.**
---
I had a choice to make: _I could recite the state-sanctioned propaganda like an obedient little dog and be rewarded with a pat on the head. Or, I could have the courage to stand for what I know to be true._
---
When I remind you of this Bible verse, you’ll know exactly which choice I made: "_For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?_ " (Mark 8:36)
---
You see, I refuse to give up on America. That’s why I’m going on trial to fight to save my home, my liberty, and __our__ Republic.
---
_Are YOU with me?_ Will you join the cause to “SAVE RUDY?”
---

Friend,
---
With the trial of my life set to begin, President Donald J. Trump just said two powerful words for the entire nation to hear...
---
**_“SAVE RUDY!”_**
---
On Thursday, I will be on trial – __without_ a jury, mind you_ – to determine whether or not I still have a home to live in. It’s a trial to save my home and a trial to fight for my basic freedoms and rights.
---
_But more than that, our nation’s very system of justice will also be on trial._
---
If the Radical Left Democrats can get away with destroying me in a weaponized court without a jury – and possibly imprisoning me – solely because I served as President Trump’s lawyer, then the rule of law is DEAD in America.
---
**Just last week, a bloodthirsty left-wing judge threatened me with contempt and imprisonment if I didn’t recite her dictated false version of covered-up massive evidence of voter fraud.**
---
I had a choice to make: _I could recite the state-sanctioned propaganda like an obedient little dog and be rewarded with a pat on the head. Or, I could have the courage to stand for what I know to be true._
---
When I remind you of this Bible verse, you’ll know exactly which choice I made: "_For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?_ " (Mark 8:36)
---
You see, I refuse to give up on America. That’s why I’m going on trial to fight to save my home, my liberty, and __our__ Republic.
---
_Are YOU with me?_ Will you join the cause to “SAVE RUDY?”
---

You see, I refuse to give up on America. That’s why I’m going on trial to fight to save my home, my liberty, and __our__ Republic.

## McCarthy, Cowboys Part Ways
The Dallas Cowboys and head coach Mike McCarthy have [parted ways](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO6yAQAL_G7rAAA3EKiteky2uvtDawDuiw14JVHP_9KddfPxqN5us-3yGXvD3_w4qe3wvNWmorpBLKzBFyOWfTR_-Q8ap69OoyusmaUes-edRSxovVcA0uODXZ4JZJLwbldURnVJ_9RyaVMkqN0qrBGqvCFB7LhJPGGDsjMWamOnBCxje0pZz0wjoEWvviE_PeuvFfp2-dvrWdKrfhhET0ATp9C3Q86GwiIUQRCEISa_5GsYYAldMpdqgsDjibgIWxikAbVwgsNnwSZ-BMWxONoRShnLZGjtIOidfSVx_3I5eSm7t0Rj5XyOW3i_8c9fL6JwAA___jLW0U) after his contract expired, ending a five-year stint that saw the Cowboys qualify for the playoffs three times but fail to advance beyond the divisional round. Initial reports suggested the two sides couldn’t agree on the length of a potential contract, but a statement from owner and general manager Jerry Jones indicated that talks never reached the negotiation stage. Coming off a 48-32 loss to the Green Bay Packers in the playoffs last year, the Cowboys [struggled this season](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LHOpCAUxfGnwQ4DF1QsKLahm223NHi5jmRRDDLj-Pab2f6rf8nJyf_PY3r4mOL-_O03svWz5AkEdFxILvUUfEz3pJtgZxFG2ZCVg-pNpxVAs9pOYO9lb0ZtxgFhNiilAT3qfhhQUWii_Y4JKbWUSnSy7XQn0eC8GDJAITAtKMSaS1tXqvTx55Lu_KbSYt6aZNdaj5OpXwwcA3ddV0vnsX-RgduXxMCdNZebgZsYuBgYOK3UaLQYv5ZfBYlv8S_xDdGXut58z5XT5yCsFHih-io7x3zN-T45Zo9rU2w4rphSPPuBafHcfEz_D9UfC70t_AsAAP__J35oOg). They finished 7-10 after losing several players to injuries, including quarterback Dak Prescott, wide receiver CeeDee Lamb, and defensive end DeMarcus Lawrence. ## Texas Leads Nation in Renewable Energy
According to data from the U.S. Energy Information Administration analyzed by consulting firm Cleanview, Texas [leads the nation](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLuOszAUhJ_GdEa-Ailc_A1d_nZLdLAPxJK5yD6E8ParZLXl1jP6NPN93Yc7xBTX-T8s6Og1bYMSynIhuTRDgJiuwVTBjSLcZIVOtrrprNFKVQ-n21HpRtubCNY2IOxkWiv05KHtBLShiu4NE1IaKbWwsrbGSt_5ceqwUxgCMwJDpC3X9EDCF5QpXdsTc-23pUruQbQXpv8x1TPVn-dZZzwIc3nnTPXjUeKKpTDV44p5vpjqPxhO2174UXghICw844onjAn5T4-PQIT54h528JEuvsB8xIz89764MdVX2YX9jCnF0rTMiHmBmD7b6E9ZT6e-AwAA__8gsW1X) in wind and solar power generation capacity and ranks second to California in battery storage capacity. The state has 42,000 megawatts (MW) of wind power, 22,000 MW of solar farms, and 6,500 MW of industrial-scale battery capacity installed. Combined, this represents roughly 80% more renewable energy generation capacity than second-place California. Rapid growth across these sectors over the past five years has fueled the state’s emergence as a leader in renewable energy, which now accounts for about 30% of the electricity generated in Texas. Since 2019, wind power has grown 50%, solar power has grown 800%, and battery storage has grown 5,500%. Battery storage is likely to be a hot topic in the state legislative session. ERCOT, the Texas power grid operator, has estimated that capacity [could reach 16,000 MW](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOhCAYhJ8GOwz8gGJBcY3dXnulQfhdSVgwwK3r2192-2tnMpMv389tudkQQ7p_2wea9tryAgwUZZxyuXgb4rXIzpuV-Yl3aPgoBq2kAOh2I-UqvR7GUa1eOA2KbcO0rdMowYlRTF0w7zPGueRcMMV7JRV32q2bRg3oPZEMfWi59G3Hhi9bt3jlJ5be5UcXzd7aUYn4IjATmM_z7N1ecnq3BOaEZyUw7_m3tpzoZ09gtqUFF5HA_EkoJiz3i9YcbaGrbQ3LRZ2NYcslBUuBMcHEpPtjP7pi_HGGGEMdRiLZ_WFD_MC0f-08DfwFAAD__5nPaAY) by the end of the year.

## Strong Winds Return to Fuel L.A. Fires
Another round of strong winds moved into the Los Angeles area on Monday, threatening progress in the [fight against historic wildfires](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvwyAQRn-NvTnCcJgwMHTJlq4dLcLdxVcREwFNlH9fpXvHT5_09PS-zus5Spb9-hlvFDqXVSttJzVPM6wYJb9WGDEwkSYzUpidWY4W7KLGLRidFNPRoUFMxODZaO9VjIzJ2QVGCW-ammeYZ2PBHUCjVRfyi47eKvYDKELppR6-i-x9I86v8qB6SOU25rD1fm-D-Rj0adCneN_p2d7Xe9QuKdOgT7m0Ke5XytSmp2RkqdSmVn76RnWfUszCpe4SJ_De8QUQwCvGGD1rtImPCS3rC7mxBrw_JWdpixtAXW9R8p9K_y_NI-jfAAAA__95WWZ8) that have destroyed thousands of homes and claimed at least 24 lives. The return of powerful, gusting winds could also present firefighters with unexpected events like the "firenado," a flaming tornado capable of producing 100 mph winds. [See the Palisades firenado here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGv3CAQhH-N3e3JYMDPhYu84propU15WsOCN8JwAvxOzq-PfH3a_XZmNPP76_GFHDmFX7jT0nx-yEFqGAQI9XDI8Xyo3i2eSNLY0yKm0Xxopc3Qb4v7EKsdV22myYyepJn0rKXxZiancJQ9L5fbIIQSYtRquinp9LDSbCTOevBzpwZy3HK5_cmc2kY-nvmbys3mvY_L1tqzduOPTt47eX-9Xre9pot18k4JjtrJ-_NYI1uo6KmdgMkB7VQCJct0cc-F3udC1R50KTByRUcVGpXC_uQU4HpL6DJYPMLWICewuFNBwAprxL8EjbBUaFvJR9gg5gqYAsV3Chb4_BSF7c_Ql8U9XxwjVzN1agg7cnwXav8b-HuR_wIAAP__XHyAkA). Over 60 square miles of land have burned as the Palisades and Eaton wildfires remain active in Southern California. Officials have issued red flag warnings, implemented curfews, and announced the evacuation of 92,000 people in Los Angeles County. [See fire maps here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0zzFvhSAUBeBfA5sGroB1YOji9rp2NCiX521QjFDJ-_eNnbp0_k7Oyfl8TA9Hkfbnh9vQlpAmEKAbIRupJu8ovibFvQ2IgB1HK_vOvGmljeCrReGGvjNeSlQAfhEwGwkOvBagxDxwsnebkFJJ2WnVt-q2GQcDbtAiDEwJ9FTS2X4l2suKIb7ShWe7pI1Hu5ZyZNa9MxgZjLXWdpnzjjXfzmCMdGHzfXhXMDMYFxcppHMn1wQ6MTeVdp__BPhp_VEpRsqmZ0o8N0fxd6v89_2y8BMAAP__xF5bvA). name: History Facts
subject: Why you shouldn't say, "as American as apple pie"
body:
Apple pie has long been emblematic of wholesome Americana. There’s even a saying tying the dessert to U.S. culture: “as American as apple pie.” [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?xtl=1krv9cfc68cfhupknd0r2oe1e38v4dyxukeh8evs549x994fpqta2rzf89fg7wxo4s0xpjhlf7hg850rcr48j4x77avn33v1if15tbxubpni5r0fyez4jfjbr83jts4ulylk5gog0s0lxyjcwqrcsmvje&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq2uz9&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

---
# [Apple pie isn't from America.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq2uz9&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [World History](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq2uz9&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq2uz9&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| A pple pie has long been emblematic of wholesome Americana. There’s even a saying tying the dessert to U.S. culture: “as American as apple pie.” But the classic treat actually originated across the ocean, in 14th-century England. The first known record of an apple pie recipe was in _The Forme of Cury_ , an English cookbook [compiled around 1390](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq2uz9&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) by King Richard II’s cooks. The recipe calls for apples, figs, raisins, pears, and spices, but unlike the dessert we know today, it didn’t call for any additional sugar. All of the ingredients were to be baked inside a hard, lard-based shell called a “coffin,” meant to be a container, not a golden, flaky crust.
---
Eventually, apple pie made its way to America with European settlers; the first recorded mention of the dessert in the U.S. was in a 1697 diary. By the late 1700s, multiple updated recipes were included in America’s first known cookbook, _American Cookery_. By the early 1800s, American farmers were growing thousands of apple varieties. Apple pie continued to [gain popularity](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq2uz9&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) through the 19th century, but it didn’t become a cultural icon until the 20th century. As early as 1902, a _New York Times_ editorial called it a symbol of American prosperity, and by the 1920s, “as American as apple pie” started to appear in print. The dessert’s position as a meaningful part of American culture was all but cemented during World War II, when soldiers proudly declared that they enlisted for “mom and apple pie.”
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq2uz9&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) | [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq2uz9&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

## Johnny Appleseed was a successful entrepreneur.
John Chapman, the real-life figure behind the legend of Johnny Appleseed, was not just a wandering folk hero, but by all accounts an astute businessman and successful entrepreneur. As a young man in the late 1700s and early 1800s, he ventured west to strategically plant apple trees across America’s frontier, from western Pennsylvania through central Ohio and into Indiana. Chapman often stayed just ahead of settlers, cultivating nurseries and orchards, then [selling them off](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq2uz9&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) when settlers arrived. It’s believed he resourcefully acquired his seeds from cider presses — at the time, apples were primarily grown for producing alcoholic cider, a major part of frontier life. Most accounts of Chapman describe him as traveling barefoot, in a burlap sack, and with a tin pot for a hat. Despite his modest life, it’s believed that when he died in 1845, Chapman still owned many properties himself, and was a wealthy man.

There’s even a saying tying the dessert to U.S. culture: “as American as apple pie.” But the classic treat actually originated across the ocean, in 14th-century England. The first known record of an apple pie recipe was in The Forme of Cury , an English cookbook by King Richard II’s cooks. The recipe calls for apples, figs, raisins, pears, and spices, but unlike the dessert we know today, it didn’t call for any additional sugar. All of the ingredients were to be baked inside a hard, lard-based shell called a “coffin,” meant to be a container, not a golden, flaky crust. Eventually, apple pie made its way to America with European settlers; the first recorded mention of the dessert in the U.S. was in a 1697 diary. By the late 1700s, multiple updated recipes were included in America’s first known cookbook, American Cookery. By the early 1800s, American farmers were growing thousands of apple varieties. Apple pie continued to through the 19th century, but it didn’t become a cultural icon until the 20th century. As early as 1902, a New York Times editorial called it a symbol of American prosperity, and by the 1920s, “as American as apple pie” started to appear in print. School choice is the #1 way to fight this indoctrination and give education back to parents.

name: Lesley Davis
subject: Worth Fighting For
body:
Our longest-held and most deeply cherished values are under attack | | | |
---
| | | Dear friends, The self-evident truths that built America as one nation, under God, are under attack. My name is Lesley Davis. I’m a Christian, a wife, a mother, a recovering lawyer, and a life-long Mississippian. I have been a political activist for decades, and I started Mississippi Advocacy Group to fight back against destructive ideology and policy that is right here in my home state. Our nation is in trouble. Our longest-held and most deeply cherished foundational values are under assault. Our devotion to our Creator, commitment to family, and love for country are in steep decline. Our social fabric is unraveling at an alarming pace. Tragically, we are becoming all too accustomed to shattered families, rising crime, rampant pornography, sexualization of children, and their indoctrination with critical race and gender theory. This decay is the product of the post-modern leftist philosophy that dominates our cultural high ground. It rejects “binary” categories like male and female, right and wrong, true and false, even sane and insane. Indeed, today’s leftist philosophy contends there are no worthwhile objective values, only subjective feelings. It has laid waste to every standard that built our nation – the value of innocent life, the dignity of work and its just rewards, and even biological reality and truth itself — all must go. All must yield to unbridled subjective feelings and the choices that result. Every barrier must be crashed through — and proudly. The rot produced by this erosion of values is not limited to spiritual or family life. Our decaying values threaten our economy, public safety, health, and national security. Are you ready to fight back? If so, [forward this to a friend!](https://us13.forward-to-friend.com/forward?u=38e7573a4604819e3af8c7b86&id=3857b0eb1a&e=6f9b7d8fd0)

This decay is the product of the post-modern leftist philosophy that dominates our cultural high ground. It rejects “binary” categories like male and female, right and wrong, true and false, even sane and insane. Indeed, today’s leftist philosophy contends there are no worthwhile objective values, only subjective feelings. name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 1/14/2025
body:
New wolf pack arrival in Western Colorado is just in time for calving season
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
Happy last week of the Biden Administration! I'm headed to the inauguration this weekend and I can barely contain my excitement. Shoot me a reply to this email and let me know if you'll be there! We'll have 4 reporters on the ground doing "Man on the Street" interviews and we'd LOVE to interview you.
🏛️ **Colorado Legislative Session Updates...** Colorado lawmakers hit the ground running as the 75th General Assembly opened last week, introducing more than 130 bills on the first day. [Ten of those bills were education-related.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Additionally, C. J. Garbo writes about early discussions indicate a strong push from Senate Democrats on a [firearms bill](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) that raises constitutional concerns.
Definitely don't miss this today's commentaries reflecting on legislative session. One from Kevin Lundberg, [critiquing Governor Polis' policies](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and calling out a disconnect between his rhetoric of freedom and the reality of his administration's overreach. Another from a new writer, Mike Dickerson, about fighting off the [‘Black Pill’ burnout](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to make a difference in legislation.
**🏔️ Here in Colorado...** CPW put out a press release this weekend that they were going to begin trapping and transporting operations to bring up to [15 Canadian Grey Wolves](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) from Canada to Western Colorado; they arrived one day later. In a hard weekend for Colorado football, Sen. Byron Pelton reflects on the [loss of CU legend, Coach McCartney](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), while Rep. Carlos Barron started off session yesterday by reflecting on the [Denver Broncos playoff loss](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and the team’s optimistic future.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** _Not featured below, but for your personal reading:_ [Grand Junction](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and [Colorado Springs](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) have deployed firefighters to California. Navy SEALs and veterans marched in D.C. to [support Pete Hegseth’s confirmation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) as Secretary of Defense. Special Counsel Jack Smith [quietly resigned](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), closing a contentious chapter of Trump investigations. Meanwhile, Trump [praised Senator Fetterman](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after a Mar-a-Lago meeting, showcasing rare bipartisan cooperation.
This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, January 14, 2025.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[New wolf pack arrival in Western Colorado is just in time for calving season](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY LINDY BROWNING, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
On Saturday, Jan. 11, Colorado Parks and Wildlife put out a press release that they were going to begin trapping and transporting operations to bring up to 15 Canadian Grey Wolves from British Columbia, Canada, to Western Colorado.
One day later, wolves were on the ground in Garfield County. A plane, operated by Lighthawk Conservation Flying, is the same plane that CPW leased in December 2023 to bring wolves from Oregon to the state.
The aircraft left Prince St. George, British Columbia, early in the morning of Jan. 12, and landed at Eagle County Airport at about 4 p.m., where witnesses on the ground saw CPW vehicles equipped with a trailer and animal crates leave the airport and head west on Interstate 70.
Eagle Airport is staffed with a U.S. Customs and Border Protection staff, which allows for the requirements under the law to import from Canada.

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!

|
---
**[Lawmakers have introduced 10 education-focused bills thus far in 75th session](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Lawmakers in Colorado introduced ten education-related bills in the 75th legislative session's opening days, addressing topics such as workforce development, food waste reduction in schools, and trauma-informed safety practices.
* Bills include grants for forestry and firefighter training, solar energy leasing to cut utility costs, and funding to turn schoolyards into community spaces, alongside efforts to improve student meals and recycling.
* Questions about funding and implementation linger, with concerns over potential burdens on local school districts as these proposals advance.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Lundberg: Should we expect more of the same in 75th legislative session?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Kevin Lundberg critiques the 75th Colorado legislative session's opening, predicting a continuation of left-leaning policies, including SB25-003, which proposes severe firearm restrictions, and SB25-005, which undermines Colorado's balanced labor laws.
* Governor Polis faces criticism for promoting himself as a moderate while implementing California-style progressive policies, including increased taxes disguised as fees and undermining local control.
* Lundberg highlights the need for genuine educational reform, including expanded school choice, rather than simply increasing funding while adhering to controversial ideological policies in public schools.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Garbo: Senate Bill 25-003 is a blatant assault on the 2nd Amendment and small business](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado’s SB25-003 proposes banning the manufacture, sale, and transfer of specific semiautomatic firearms and devices, raising concerns about Second Amendment violations and its potential impact on law-abiding citizens.
* The bill threatens Colorado's firearm-related small businesses, including dealers, gunsmiths, and manufacturers, by imposing severe restrictions and penalties, jeopardizing jobs and economic stability.
* Opponents argue that similar restrictive gun laws have failed to reduce violent crime in Colorado, with violent crime rates increasing despite measures like magazine capacity limits and red flag laws.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Dickerson: Fighting off the ‘Black Pill’ burnout to make a difference in legislation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_On the heels of a contentious presidential election in 2024, Colorado has transitioned into a state legislative session filled to the brim with bills all but guaranteed to further the divide between the political Left and Right._
_Instead of addressing the near billion-dollar budget deficit, the Democrat majority began the session with Senate Bill 25-003, a draconian firearms bill by Sen. Tom Sullivan. It will not stand up to constitutional scrutiny, and whispers of later bills that will attack TABOR protections (Rep. Sean Camacho, we’re watching you)._
_It’s no wonder many, myself included, are dealing with the dreaded Black Pill burn out. There has been no break, seemingly for ages, to the overwhelming number of governmental issues that are thrown at us every day. But there is a light at the end of the tunnel._

Governor Polis faces criticism for promoting himself as a moderate while implementing California-style progressive policies, including increased taxes disguised as fees and undermining local control. Lundberg highlights the need for genuine educational reform, including expanded school choice, rather than simply increasing funding while adhering to controversial ideological policies in public schools. | Colorado’s SB25-003 proposes banning the manufacture, sale, and transfer of specific semiautomatic firearms and devices, raising concerns about Second Amendment violations and its potential impact on law-abiding citizens. The bill threatens Colorado's firearm-related small businesses, including dealers, gunsmiths, and manufacturers, by imposing severe restrictions and penalties, jeopardizing jobs and economic stability. Opponents argue that similar restrictive gun laws have failed to reduce violent crime in Colorado, with violent crime rates increasing despite measures like magazine capacity limits and red flag laws. | On the heels of a contentious presidential election in 2024, Colorado has transitioned into a state legislative session filled to the brim with bills all but guaranteed to further the divide between the political Left and Right. Instead of addressing the near billion-dollar budget deficit, the Democrat majority began the session with Senate Bill 25-003, a draconian firearms bill by Sen. Tom Sullivan. name: The Babylon Bee
subject: What Americans love more than bacon
body:
Without our Babylon Bee subscribers, I firmly believe that FREE SPEECH wouldn’t have become such a major issue this election.

| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zap80vq7cr3vat9pbleapk94f90306ns30jihhv0_rp22sh2s8i6epj3c3jm6pr4c5h2bs)
---
|
---
Friend, Voters have made their voices heard.Turns out the American people care deeply about two things: the cost of bacon and a censorship regime that silences its critics. For years, the left has used the liberal "news" media to spread their woke agenda, but it was largely behind closed doors. **That all changed when Twitter silenced The Babylon Bee for telling a joke.** The absurdity of a tech giant deplatforming a satirical site woke a sleeping giant.**_Enter Elon Musk._** Elon purchased Twitter and joined The Babylon Bee in starting a revolution that catapulted free speech to the election's frontlines.
---
[ Join The Fight - Subscribe to The Babylon Bee](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zrf1h5spq795k9omqi9607ip107goa7qs4vbv6bo_rp22sh2s8i6epj3c3jm6pr4c5h2bs)
---
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2ztsikhrc6vddv9lnjh1h8pr3hjb64nmn2np28qug_rp22sh2s8i6epj3c3jm6pr4c5h2bs)
---
_But, before millions gave censorship the middle finger at the polls,**it was our subscribers who stood strong against the left 's suppression of thought.**_**Without our Babylon Bee subscribers, I firmly believe that FREE SPEECH wouldn 't have become such a major issue this election.** **[If you appreciate humor, I hope you'll subscribe to The Babylon Bee and join this growing revolution for truth, debate, and the free exchange of ideas.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z0r8ki9t3omoiqs4p7k5m9lm8c9nm0hqtai896e8_rp22sh2s8i6epj3c3jm6pr4c5h2bs)**
---
[ Yes, I'll Stand With The Babylon Bee](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z9fca0gf3qr6jq7nif31mneagatahaie568rhg4g_rp22sh2s8i6epj3c3jm6pr4c5h2bs)
---

subject: no more gas cars or RVs?
body:
Peter, Did you know? New Jersey has two laws in place that will limit or halt the manufacturing of gas-powered vehicles from
|
---
| Peter, Did you know? New Jersey has _two_ laws in place that will limit or halt the manufacturing of gas-powered vehicles from now through the end of the decade.
1. **The Advanced Clean Truck rule** went into effect **Jan. 1, 2025**. It will require manufacturers of large vehicles (RVs, school buses, trucks etc.) to produce an increasing number of “zero emissions” vehicles (not gas powered) over the next decade.
2. **The Advanced Clean Car II** program will go into effect in **2035**. It will BAN the manufacturing of _any_ gas-powered vehicles.

Let’s be real. This is madness. Murphy is forcing EVERY NEW VEHICLE in New Jersey to be electric by 2035.

subject: I crashed the UN’s “Gun Ban Club” meeting
body:
[](http://trk.thedcbugle.com/?xtl=32mjhzb4zq4gxliiu5fuxrg6li6vwsdoxsnu3eulginw64pnn5x4ttuhq6gb8z2y5b4tyon0t93p73hq93rdkda804e2kww02o98lqdyi6xf&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq2zmm&__onlt=h) [unsubscribe](http://trk.thedcbugle.com/?xul=65a6x69jow166j32nk1khhb19go5i9fc7d8n6a6d56dreyulm8m1zyfc3zy12pgq9s3pbfrzjp6n854b820sikt3y84s85f9g&__stmp=sq2zmm&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
---
Please read the message below from our sponsor.
* * *
|
---
| | | | | | | |

Dear Fellow Patriot,

The United Nations' "Small Arms Treaty" has been the Gun Control Lobby's crown jewel since Barack Obama sent it to the US Senate and insisted we ratify it a decade ago. Year after year, we refused.

_But each and every day, the UN is getting closer to implementing the terms of this dangerous Treaty's provisions here in the United States even without ratification_.

**And it's all being done in secret by the UN's allies in the Washington, D.C. "Swamp."**

The good news is, with the big changes in Washington due to the 2024 election, you and I have a chance to stop the Gun Control Lobby cold.

But it's an opportunity that won't last forever.

That's why -- as Dudley Brown, President of the National Association for Gun Rights, explains in the message below -- **[it's absolutely critical you and I act now!](http://trk.thedcbugle.com/?xtl=88my8nptvxg7up2cppl19zen4s89oc0qriyk4benk234hjaylg9nf9or5bkrsm7og77clswmlj6i3ueaxh5kqksd0bi8xmxw10uhcvzp56bkgm9ayjbpoci0hcxl9vuob7j7pvycf9r7gh2ziq21rlhftqh16plftzhhels9ivwzoyhqq4v1b6&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq2zmm&__onlt=h)**

**Sincerely,

The Hon. Rand Paul
U.S. Senator (R-KY)**

* * *

Fellow Patriot,

**There is a sword hanging over the head of every American gun owner.**

I'm referring to the UN "Small Arms Treaty" -- the first stage of the UN's global gun control agenda.

_I've stared these global gun banners in the face and told them what they could do with their precious "Small Arms Treaty," though I knew the UN would NOT like me crashing their "Gun Ban Club" in Geneva_.

_**I told UN bureaucrats you and I will NEVER surrender to their anti-gun schemes!**_

When I told these anti-gun international bureaucrats they were walking in the footsteps of every 20th century murderous dictator who disarmed their citizens to shuffle them off to death camps, I guess my words hit a little "close to home."

All they could do in response was squirm in their seats and laugh nervously...

But while you or I or even President Trump can tell these gun grabbers what we think of their treaty, only the U.S. Senate can remove the treaty document from the Senate agenda.

**[That's why I'm counting on you to sign your "NO UN GUN BAN" petition to your U.S. Senators IMMEDIATELY](http://trk.thedcbugle.com/?xtl=88my8nptvxg7up2cppl19zen4s89oc0qrjzt5yuxj8yfzppqnbdvaew3k44q4333f305v8yxm0gteij6xlgn6ll2qek0m8xmagran2ccgblftabtpyscmkigrgm9ktpv4v4l91sexqk95yq6g58juhi0fsmz0skzjzscjruzhxz1v1n8u8u25j&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq2zmm&__onlt=h)**.

As you'll see, this petition insists your Senators act to oppose and reject the UN "Small Arms Treaty" and send it back to the President where it can be formally and finally trashed.

But until they do, the UN "Small Arms Treaty" will remain pending in the Senate, and ratification by a future Senate is all that's needed for this gun grab to become reality.

_And that's REGARDLESS of who occupies the White House or their position on the Treaty_!

With this Treaty, the UN's goal is to DESTROY the legal buying, owning, manufacturing, and selling of pistols, rifles, and shotguns by FORCING: **> > _ALL countries involved in the export of firearms -- including the United States -- to establish a "National Control System_."**
This is nothing more than GUN REGISTRATION, plain and simple -- the first step toward outright GUN CONFISCATION; **> > _ALL firearms manufacturers who seek to export firearms to ask for permission and report on how they believe the guns they sell will be used_.**
The UN ultimately wants final say on whether or not any firearms transfer should be allowed. Period. After all, they know guns in the hands of the "wrong" people is the biggest threat they face toward imposing their brand of one-world socialism around the globe; and **> > _ALL Treaty countries to allow firearms manufacturers to be sued for crimes committed with their products_.**
Imagine how outrageous it would be if Ford was sued because an F-150 owner ran a red light and caused a crash! That's what gun grabbers want to do with firearms because they know this could END gun manufacturing. This is exactly what Mexico is attempting to do in their lawsuit against Smith & Wesson. _**The UN's ultimate plan for all civilian-owned guns:_Incinerate them_**_ It's hard to see how the Second Amendment could survive in the United States were the one-world socialists at the UN to get their way.

Of course, that's their goal.

_To them, your Second Amendment freedoms are a threat to their grand "utopian" designs_.

Meanwhile, enemies like Red China are so eager to see every American disarmed, they're pouring money into the UN "Small Arms Treaty" hand-over-fist.

So, it's no wonder why they're hell-bent on forcing the U.S. to submit to this globalist gun control scam -- and why we must defeat it!

**[I'm counting on you to help beat the UN by signing your "NO UN GUN BAN" petition to urge your U.S. Senators to end all support for the UN Gun Ban and send it back to the White House right away](http://trk.thedcbugle.com/?xtl=88my8nptvxg7up2cppl19zen4s89oc0qrka06v8hir6uqf25zx9dwndecumodhkgdkew30ahw4u3un1ay4uzl1tpehldl6x1oaoshxg4w99a535m4n8396jzljkwzr8bvgod4vmgpwtmspbbdirfxdi85tc8gvjupz1y1hx1gzbrbrd2yot2xd&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq2zmm&__onlt=h)**.

If we don't dispose of the treaty quickly, the gun grabbers will leap to ratify the Treaty in the U.S. Senate the moment they have the votes, no matter who the President is or what their stance is on the treaty.

_That's why we have to mount a massive campaign to send this Treaty back to the President NOW so he can kill the Treaty as promised, before it's too late_.

The great news is, just doing so puts you and me in a win/win situation.

Either we get the 60 votes we need to finally KILL this Treaty...

... Or anti-gun U.S. Senators will be on record in support of arguably the **WORST anti-gun initiative** to come before either chamber of Congress in decades.

Believe me.

_U.S. Senators who vote to allow international bureaucrats to trample on our gun rights will pay the price at the ballot box_.

Just like they did in 2014 after their all-out push for gun control in the wake of the Newtown tragedy, and in 2016 after Hillary Clinton's full embrace of every anti-gun policy imaginable, and in **2024 when 4 anti-gun democrats went down in flames, and 4 more barely hung on by the skin of their teeth.**

_But if we don't fight now, it could be the gun grabbers who get the last laugh -- even if it takes them years to regain control of the U.S. Senate_!

After all, gun grabbers have been battling for this scheme since President Bill Clinton's administration.

_They're going to do whatever it takes to make their global gun control crown jewel a reality_.

subject: ☕Coffee w/ the Chairman

body:
2025 Legislative Plan - Part Four - Rules | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/3e3ffdc4e100/n41kepo7ku-12727037?e=25844e23a8)
---
| | [ ](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=fd16db2c99&e=25844e23a8)
---
| |
#### Good Morning Republicans,

_"Fight the good fight of the faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called when you made your good confession in the presence of many witnesses."_
**\-- 1 Timothy 6:12**

2025 will be a year of greatness for the individual and the state and the country. I believe it will be a year of many "good confessions" of faith to many witnesses. Being unapologetic as a Christian is not so much about the overt boisterous proclamation from the hilltop, but a firm foundation of confidence to no longer being a silent (majority) when evil and wrong seem to be popular.

Trendy cultural or societal views towards family or men/women or education or meritocracy or even to the epitome of what Americanism is, must be met with consistent resistance. We must wear the full armor of God, all the time, to know that even as we take slings and arrows for what is right and just...the battle is purposeful and meaningful.

Eternal life requires one to take hold of a measured beyond reproach mindset and intentional way of living so God's plan can come to fruition.
* * *
For any governing body to operate, they must have an established set of rules to define procedure and fairness. The body promulgates the rules, amends by a majority or higher threshold vote and then proceeds to conduct its business.

**The first and most important conversation that must be addressed by the Senators is the Rules. I have repeated this message weekly as it is the pivot point to which all opportunity for a productive legislative session hinges on.**

_If our Cloture threshold, the amount of votes it takes to end a filibuster, is not lowered to match the Governor's veto we will have a very frustrating session._

10 other states have differing Governor Veto and Filibuster thresholds but none with as HIGH of a threshold to the cloture AND as a Unicameral, we don't have an offsetting House or Senate to provide a differing governing body to move legislation forward.

This effort to bring focus to the Rules comes directly from the NEGOP Central Committee, a governing body of 150 Republicans from ACROSS the state and similar in representation to the Legislative Districts. This body is elected by and large from over 3000 County delegates to represent the Republican Platform...the values of the party. The Central Committee drafted a Legislative Plan, a mandate no different than that of American people, who want EFFECTIVE and PURPOSEFUL solutions...TODAY. Not next year, not in 5 years...not incrementally so we can FEEL better as Nebraska Nice.

Now is the time for BOLD leadership to see the need for modernization our Unicameral process and listen to the Will of the People. **"3/5 for Vetoes, 3/5 for Cloture: A Balanced Approach"**
**NEBRASKA REPUBLICAN PARTY
LEGISLATIVE PLAN FOR NEBRASKA
109th Legislature, 1st Regular Session, 2025** The integrity of the Unicameral is in the effectiveness to purposefully and meaningfully benefit Nebraskans, NOT a select few special interests.
_MODERNIZE NEBRASKA LEGISLATIVE RULES TO REFLECT
“WE THE PEOPLE”_ The integrity of the Nebraska Unicameral has been eroded by outdated rules that do not promote best practices for legislation and the needs of its citizens. It is way overdue for legislators to change their procedural rules to make the legislative process fairer and more efficient.
* **Lower the Cloture Vote Threshold**
* Advocate for lowering the cloture vote threshold in the Nebraska Legislature to facilitate smoother passage of key legislative initiatives, ensuring that important bills are not indefinitely stalled by minority obstruction. **Change the cloture vote requirement to 3/5's (30)**. The number to override a Governor or a minority group in the legislature should be the same.

* **The Issue:** The current 2/3 cloture rule gives a small minority (17) of legislators undue AND ABUSED power to block important legislation, even when it has broad support.
* **The Solution:** Aligning the cloture threshold with the Governor's veto override threshold (3/5 or 30) creates a more balanced and democratic process.
* **The Benefits:**
* Faster Progress: Allows the legislature to address critical issues like:
* Economic Development: LOWERED TAXES
* **Election Security: Voter Verification & Election Accountability**
* Education Priority: Support Teachers & Students
* Energy & Land Independence: Nebraska’s Land & Resources for Nebraskans
* Political Restructuring: The salvation of the State.
* Accountability: Ensures legislation reflects the will of the majority of the people.

Fairness: Aligns legislative procedures with the established standard for overriding gubernatorial vetoes. No other state has anything close to Nebraska's imbalance of voting leverage.
**"30 for the Governor, 30 for the people. It's common sense."**

We have driven and determined leaders across this state that will be building relations with our elected leaders on YOUR behalf to implement our Legislative Plan, are forthcoming Political Plan, and returning the influence BACK to the people and away from consultants or special interests that are only driven by money and power.
The truth shall set us free.
Blessings,
---
|
---
| –Chairman Underwood
---
| | This was the VISION and OBJECTIVE TRUTHS of 2024...nothing changes without YOU.
2025 NEGOP VISION
In 2025, the Republican Party of Nebraska is going ALL-IN on the VALUES of Education, ALL-IN on Election Accountability and Voter Verification, ALL-IN on Tax Reform, ALL-IN on Protecting Human Rights. This will come to fruition in our Legislative Plan and through the voices of the people who will expect the very most from their elected representatives. The groundwork has been completed and in 2025 it will all come down to a choice by EVERY Republican. The choice is to remove oneself from the party politics and personalities normally associated with power and money AND engage at the doorstep of Nebraskans sharing the truth of our values because our values bring the solutions to local struggles of taxes, community safety, election security, & educational excellence. The Values of the Republican Party resonate with Nebraskans. We are reaching out and connecting in 2025 and this will be a victory for Conservative Principles.

Nebraskans are thirsting for people of courage, people of honesty and truth...they are hungry for leaders to say what they are going to do...AND...then DO what they say! I am beyond measure proud of the Republican grassroots and coalitions. They HAVE created stability within this organization.

Every false narrative sowing chaos is an attempt by those who seek their power back. The Republicans who prioritize our principles are actively fulfilling the objectives of the party by doing maintenance of the government of, by, and for the people AND furthering their principles within the community. And this effort will continue to grow and grow as more principled Republicans join the efforts. I see this growth and stability EVERYWHERE in Nebraska now. Dixon County, Seward County, Gage County, York County, Sarpy County, Saline County, Madison, Keith, Hall, and on and on...and the growth and stability is coming FROM the people. From leaders of the party, who CHOOSE to grow and build their counties because the people matter and connecting people to our values matters. Common Nebraskans, who say enough is enough...who choose to sacrifice their time to become better every day and engage more volunteers to make more engagement opportunities. From County Chairs and Secretaries, committeemen and women, elected officials to candidates, they SEE the reality of what strong, healthy County Parties can do. These next 3-4 months there will be a purposeful and respectful focus of engagement to demographics and people who share conservative values. We are going ALL-IN on to be a resource for local campaigns and local elected positions such as school boards, city council, county seats, NRD's, power boards. We are going ALL-IN on people of Nebraska who make Nebraska the ‘Good Life’. –Chairman Underwood
---

subject: The New York Sun is Different
body:

| | Dear Reader, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I’ve experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today’s media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It’s a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun’s deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don’t agree with everything that can be found in the Sun’s pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I’ve been impressed by the Sun’s growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun’s success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

| | Dear Friend in Faith, Please -- for the sake of all our families -- take it from me as someone who's lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life...You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace. But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue's Clues_...

subject: An opportunity to rebuild the Democratic Party
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

I have a big announcement, Peter:

Today, Justice Democrats is officially launching our 2026 Candidate
Recruitment campaign!

With far-right control of the White House, U.S. Senate, and Congress, it’s
clear the Democratic Party is a failure. In 2026, we have an opportunity
to rebuild it to be a party led by and for working-class people against
the billionaire and corporate class — but to do that, our work must start
now.

To build the resources needed to run as many working-class candidates for
Congress as possible, we need to kick-start our fundraising and bring in
$100,000 by February 1st. It’s no small task, but with people power, I
know we can make it happen.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250114-1?refcode=em20250114-36315&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36315_1203867_KU0Un-&akid=36315%2E1203867%2EKU0Un- ]Will you rush a grassroots contribution of $5 or more
right now to kick-start our campaign and help us reach our critical
fundraising goal?

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250114-1?refcode=em20250114-36315&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=36315_1203867_KU0Un-&akid=36315%2E1203867%2EKU0Un- ]2026 Candidate recruitment starts now. Donate

Justice Democrats was formed in 2017 to change the majority millionaire
makeup of Congress by recruiting and electing a diverse slate of working
people who have shared the struggles of the communities they represent.
Who understands what it’s like to navigate our broken healthcare system or
live paycheck to paycheck. Since then, we’ve elected progressive champions
like Rashida Tlaib, AOC, and Summer Lee who are creating real change that
benefits working people across the country.

We’ve recruited former principals, nurses, restaurant workers, and
community organizers to take on Democratic incumbents with decades of
power, corporate-fueled war chests, and the backing of Party
establishment, and won thanks to the support of this grassroots movement.

Now, we’re gearing up to do it again in 2026 — finding, recruiting, and
training candidates and making sure their campaigns are ready to take on
corporate Democrats who’ve lost touch with working people.

But political campaigns are more expensive than ever before in history
thanks to the influx of dark money from Super PACs like AIPAC and Wall
Street-backed Crypto, and it took a tremendous amount of resources to
elect our current slate of progressive champions in Congress.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250114-1?refcode=em20250114-36315&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=36315_1203867_KU0Un-&akid=36315%2E1203867%2EKU0Un- ]If we’re going to make big gains in 2026 and turn this Party around for
the people, we need your support right now. Can we count on you to chip in
today, Peter?

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250114-1?refcode=em20250114-36315&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36315_1203867_KU0Un-&akid=36315%2E1203867%2EKU0Un- ]Contribute $5

I and everyone on Team JD cannot thank you enough for your support as we
fight for the leaders and future we deserve.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20250114-36315-footer&t=1002&refcode2=36315_1203867_KU0Un-&akid=36315%2E1203867%2EKU0Un-

body:

# **Pete Hegseth: The Wrong Choice for America’s Defense**
---
| | | | | [ ](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2w2ush-t0rqid-kyd76rh6/)
---
| | | | Dear friend, we need to talk about this. Today, the country watched in horror as Trump's confirmation hearings centered around National Defense. Pete Hegseth—a former Fox News commentator with a history of inflammatory rhetoric, financial mismanagement, and personal misconduct—faced his Senate confirmation hearing for Secretary of Defense. If his sneering response to serious allegations is any indication, he is wholly unfit for the role.
**A Danger to America’s Safety and Integrity** During the hearing, Senator Jack Reed systematically dismantled Hegseth’s credibility, citing: **1.) Racist and sexist remarks** that divide our military. **2.) Financial incompetence** that bankrupted a nonprofit under his leadership. **3.) Personal misconduct** involving excessive drinking, partying, and troubling allegations of sexual assault.
Hegseth’s own words from his book, _American Crusade: Our Fight to Stay Free_ , further reveal his divisive mindset: He claims _“the modern Democratic Party literally hates the foundational ideas of America.”_ He openly declares **_“the left is not our friend.”_** How can someone who views half the country as the enemy be trusted to lead a bipartisan military charged with protecting _all Americans_?
**The Pentagon Is Not a Fox News Studio** Hegseth’s sneer during Senator Reed’s pointed critique said it all. He isn’t interested in accountability—he’s interested in partisan theatrics. The Department of Defense requires leadership with integrity, competence, and respect for the law. Hegseth’s track record of failure, misconduct, and divisiveness makes him a threat to the very principles he claims to defend.
**America Deserves Better** This isn’t just about one man—it’s about the safety, security, and unity of our nation. Allowing someone like Pete Hegseth to oversee an $900 billion defense budget is a risk America cannot afford to take. We must stand up against this nomination and demand leaders who represent all Americans, not just those who fit their political agenda. [**_We are going to use our platform to call out every mess MAGA brings to our door, and we want your help in calling out the dangers they pose to the country. We know we deserve better, so we need to demand better. Join us today._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2w2ush-t0rqie-kyd76rh7/)

body:

| **__Guy Ciarrocchi_ : Republicans will learn that governing is harder than winning_**
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=18d5fcb2ec&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
|
* * *
---
| "Governing is harder than winning an election. Governing effectively is even harder. We’re watching this in real time for Trump and congressional Republicans.

Governing is even more difficult for Republicans who have to contend with opposition from Democrats — and their multiple deep-pocketed and confrontational allies. This includes governors, mayors, and school boards pledging to block presidential policies. Plus, they must overcome the legacy media, many already criticizing GOP policies, politicians and priorities—and, highlighting and supporting criticisms leveled by the Left. But Team Trump knows how to overcome all of that.

However, governing effectively gets even harder for Republicans when they beat each other up, questioning the policies or motives of their 'friends', or when they put egos or personalities above success...."
