| | Dear Fellow American, Classic children's literature is being ignored and eliminated from our nation's classrooms at an alarming rate. Beloved classics like _The Wind in the Willows_ , _Treasure Island_ , and _The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ are just a few of the foundational books that are rarely being taught to our nation's children today. Not only does this rob young people of classic tales of adventure and friendship, but they also rob children of fundamental lessons about the world and how best to live.
---
| | That's why Hillsdale College released a free online course titled **" Classic Children's Literature."** Perhaps you've had a chance to watch a few lectures. **Today, I 'm excited to tell you that the course is now available on DVD! And you can get your very own box set right now!** [**" Classic Children's Literature"**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=431eca5388bb46c08e4b799bc7bc9724&_e=pR_1tWkCiBpZnYqb5gNdd46gCR3IHU1qjaBnlZXrYjEgb3L4Vg86RLpIGZqLHZSuApW5VR962xJI_UvfZ9KM963YWrc2PG0GuO-KCxEF_b-e2iFzZVxSGA2e2lL3UR-U6LNhX4JqW1xTkR1gmfJ2l-wCa8D-VoGGbb-Qswo7m9bZF4uw5NyakmAcrJp8UENU1lO7B2YCtpOFnjq9iKvbrJ7IsGFq5QMZam8gMGpdCVPhZfdnh_OAlpPLuK9pus6yDG1rUKPyErqY0loYWsTrQPHviKlJok65RjGIloTIb5P5E_qBOMdFXyixSitWaNsXcd14kEVCTvLFANf5eADyl4u8CMIvXZohHOiX7MmUuwYCB83D5Kk_02RfnDSZSVCp0VnhNyFJRQMWxpC1nVle1yt01lFUJbRYFpKCJJ_NglpRYolU9MtH00AWK9kPwtjj) explores some of the greatest works of children's literature, from Aesop and the classic fairy tales to _Treasure Island_ and _Winnie-the-Pooh_ , and so much more. When you get your box set today, you will not only delight your family, but also evoke a sense of wonder while teaching timeless lessons to the young and old alike.
---
| [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=431eca5388bb46c08e4b799bc7bc9724&_e=pR_1tWkCiBpZnYqb5gNdd46gCR3IHU1qjaBnlZXrYjEgb3L4Vg86RLpIGZqLHZSuApW5VR962xJI_UvfZ9KM963YWrc2PG0GuO-KCxEF_b-e2iFzZVxSGA2e2lL3UR-U6LNhX4JqW1xTkR1gmfJ2l-wCa8D-VoGGbb-Qswo7m9bZF4uw5NyakmAcrJp8UENU1lO7B2YCtpOFnjq9iKvbrJ7IsGFq5QMZam8gMGpdCVPhZfdnh_OAlpPLuK9pus6yDG1rUKPyErqY0loYWsTrQPHviKlJok65RjGIloTIb5Piv2_ZfML85sScTvKMFuqDtAthSRZ3BaWVtWy-J3rsPJT4E1i5o7ggTyCXfwwpmXklaotMdyxJIk6TQkykHrNgJMNzJpeUQ07L0POlW_p64PFnRvG1ESK9KbFetqK63cNKp5fC9iousIahN11-C_L1)

Speaker Mike Johnson, Sebastian Gorka, Pete Hegseth
## A House Speaker Who Holds the Bible Above the Constitution
Let's start with House Speaker Mike Johnson, who began a recent House session with a fabricated prayer to Jesus Christ that he falsely claimed Thomas Jefferson recited every day during his presidency. Jefferson did no such thing. The first record of that prayer existing is from 1919--over a century after Jefferson left office.
But Johnson's goal wasn't historical accuracy; it was advancing his Christian nationalist agenda. And while he misrepresents Jefferson's faith, he wholly ignores what Jefferson actually _did_ do. Thomas Jefferson:
* Literally re-wrote his own Bible.
* Vociferously advocated for the separation of church and state.
* Hosted the first White House Iftar during Ramadan.
* Owned a Qur'an and respected the religious pluralism of America.
* Contemplated Muslims into his Virginia Statute of Religious Freedom.

Of course, Johnson won't mention these facts, because they don't fit his vision of an America governed by Christian theocracy. Johnson also won't mention that Jefferson was an enslaver, and raped and impregnated Sally Hemings, an Black enslaved child. I suppose it is difficult for Johnson to acknowledge, much less condemn, this fact, given he voted for Donald Trump, a civil court adjudicated rapist himself. But given that Johnson is House Speaker, yet believes the [Bible supersedes the US Constitution](https://substack.com/redirect/572a5402-d85f-48b2-ad75-f324354315b6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), it's hard to tell what he actually believes? And while he's perfectly entitled to his personal opinion, in a secular government, the person second in line to be the President shouldn't be so willing to undermine the US Constitution he is sworn to uphold as the supreme law of the land.
And sadly, the threat of Christian nationalism goes far beyond Johnson's theatrics. It's embedded in the very fabric of MAGA politics.

## **A Counter-Terrorism Director Who Thinks Islam Is Suspicious**
Let's talk about Sebastian Gorka, who Trump appointed as Deputy Assistant to the President and Senior Director for Counter-Terrorism. This is a problem for many reasons. First, Gorka is a man with [a documented history of Nazi fraternizin](https://substack.com/redirect/01feb17b-4558-4ffb-b0cb-3f341a3f5e3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)g and con artistry, yet he landed a high-level position in the White House with immense power.
Likewise, last week Gorka was on television advising Americans to report _" suspicious behavior"_--such as _"[converting to Islam](https://substack.com/redirect/31771b99-0ae3-43d4-8b6a-b778dc01a2ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."_ Yes, the man in charge of counter-terrorism believes that practicing a constitutionally protected religion is inherently suspicious.
Finally, his Nazi affiliations and Islamophobic rhetoric notwithstanding, [Hungary has issued arrest warrants for Gorka](https://substack.com/redirect/c6d61ba4-2a9f-4ad4-9cb1-857c0d24d64a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) due to illegal weapons and ammunition charges. And given that the role of senior director for counter-terrorism does not require Senate confirmation, it is mortifying that this man will have the direct ear of Donald Trump.
This is the kind of rhetoric that fuels hate crimes and discrimination. It's the kind of rhetoric that emboldens the state to target marginalized communities in the name of security. And it's a stark reminder that MAGA isn't about law and order--it's about white supremacy disguised as Christian nationalism. ## **A Secretary of Defense Who Wants a Christian Military**
Enter Pete Hegseth, who Trump is considering for Secretary of Defense. Here's what to keep in mind during Hegseth's Senate confirmation hearings. Hegseth has openly declared _" Kill all Muslims!" _[according to eye witness testimony](https://substack.com/redirect/b4e05157-df0e-41bc-bf55-1f0f8354e85b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). He wears [tattoos with Nazi and white supremacy affiliations](https://substack.com/redirect/71504ebe-2548-475b-90bf-7e492c806911?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). He sees himself as a modern-day crusader who wants to [turn the military into a Christian weapon](https://substack.com/redirect/97607524-62af-4611-922f-fcbc1af29752?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), according to his recent books.

As Politico [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/97607524-62af-4611-922f-fcbc1af29752?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> "Wilson's denomination opposes religious pluralism and embraces the idea of a nation founded on the premise that Jesus Christ is the 'lord of all.' This isn't a fringe ideology. It's becoming mainstream in Republican politics. name: Reid Rasner, CEO
subject: A key shift in what it means to retire
body:
| Hi Peter, Does retirement mean you'll be done working for the rest of your life? That may seem like a silly question, but more people planning for retirement these days are answering, "no."1 In fact, some of today's retirees who thought they'd _never_ work again are now rethinking that. And it's not all about money. Many retirees want to do something meaningful. They're also rethinking other ideas — and the plans they put in place — before they retired.
---
|
---
[**Click here to see it!**](https://financeinsights.net/WaLmFYnW7hY77QqH7wwqLTEVwxL?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) The truth is the experience of retirement can be a whole lot different than we ever anticipated. Figuring out how our assumptions may be off can give us a better grip on what we really need to plan for. And a simple way to do that is by cherry-picking some wisdom from people who're already retired — and who wish they could go back and do a few things differently. [**Want to learn some little-known, powerful retirement lessons from people who've lived it? name: David Horowitz
subject: the enemy within
body:
The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against.| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=77db23c74cd2491fb193d1cb843a0e75&_e=OJvTd-TYaeEF2udkqpgMes78I6DJ6nWacdrTmnySAmNNCuyCow5Fz9OOPsLgWDstLCEebKIeUl3RbVLnh9ZUtm6_vjOcI4G9exn-DuA3AwhKBuLpCsP0tnkRgKNc6ocjdL4SnIdBgvLBh26WQ_k_ptwA_nCe2ncKyov-mOk7TzQs4TUhD84f3HDFrhKe1SvWPT9jdq1vGpZQ2741qNP1jKOfCPAy9w8eCVkGuPtYWcmn8WGFLTD3MzkmhqFbiUW6oEj8PsGHkIekSjy3RgqNQI3IrXmou0mEQ4q06m_952p14OY_6o5ZuObdFFXMV7wWXSwx7jC64YM84i6u2-5M0lfbzACmBjgJ1psWkCMVQk7c5Ts_FMGKPz2AUGtfAKLXpmHNAiSM8Wumy2Oi5SJ35A%3D%3D)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=77db23c74cd2491fb193d1cb843a0e75&_e=OJvTd-TYaeEF2udkqpgMes78I6DJ6nWacdrTmnySAmNNCuyCow5Fz9OOPsLgWDstLCEebKIeUl3RbVLnh9ZUtm6_vjOcI4G9exn-DuA3AwhKBuLpCsP0tnkRgKNc6ocjdL4SnIdBgvLBh26WQ_k_ptwA_nCe2ncKyov-mOk7TzQs4TUhD84f3HDFrhKe1SvWPT9jdq1vGpZQ2741qNP1jKOfCPAy9w8eCVkGuPtYWcmn8WGFLTD3MzkmhqFbiUW6Fk2_RJXNKXF9MHsOrf02eFFLKPbLnf2RgKV9SdxcJD8oQWfFUU9BegQ1Vb5ANR_89_LNOllayvLeHG57rII1A3yJe9Sxd1h8CCo6vsODnBB71FzbamMbbR2Li7ohXO3yePgflvhT9UgAZCAie4039Q%3D%3D)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.
---
| | Sincerely,
---
---
David Horowitz

Peter — Mikie Sherrill here.

In a few moments, I’m going to ask you to make a [_**Founding Contribution to my campaign for Governor of New Jersey.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/100377773/522566803/18178104?refcode=BLU_EM_ASFG_2025-01-14_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzYyMTc2OTgtOGNkMi1lZjExLTg4ZDAtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZDkyIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=__LPRLjDHWradprOXYW8Gs3pNbQWpgZDYdPiLQIZ_c4=) But first, I hope you’ll give me a moment to explain why your early support is so meaningful.

After this last election, we know people are more divided than ever on how we move forward.

With Donald Trump in the White House, folks are worried about how much he’ll roll back our fundamental rights. They’re worried about how he’ll attack our freedoms. Frankly, they’re worried if we’ll be able to get anything done at all.

**We cannot afford to lose the New Jersey governor’s race this year. Democratic governors are the first line of defense against Donald Trump and his extremist agenda, and nothing is more important to me than fighting for New Jersey.**

As a Navy helicopter pilot, as an Assistant U.S. Attorney, and as a Member of Congress, I’ve always been willing to take on anyone and everyone to serve the people and deliver results. _I’ve never turned away from a tough fight — and this will be no different._

We can win this race and get to work on New Jersey’s future, but we need to do it the same way we always have — **together.**

Grassroots support has always been the key ingredient to our success — from 2018, when we flipped New Jersey’s 11th District blue for the first time in decades, to winning reelection three cycles in a row — earning more votes than any other New Jersey House Democrat in 2022 and 2024.

We’ve built one of the most powerful grassroots movements the Garden State has ever seen, and if we’re going to win this race for New Jersey’s future, we need to get to work right now.

for America a fun, wide-ranging interview where she talked about President Trump, her faith, being a grandma and of course
-laughter! Roseanne has a lot to say; if you haven't heard yet, tune into this crowd favorite! Like, share and subscribe.

[] [] [] January 14, 2025 • Newsletter Roseanne Barr Unfiltered ENCORE Moms for America Weekly Podcast [] [] Moms for America Weekly Podcast [] Roseanne Barr is one of the most successful female comedians in entertainment history. It's no surprise that her exclusive interview with Moms for America was one of the top podcast episodes of 2024! The one and only creator and star of "Roseanne" sat down with Debbie Kraulidis on the Tucker Carlson tour in Texas. She gave Moms for America a fun, wide-ranging interview where she talked about President Trump, her faith, being a grandma and of course -laughter! Roseanne has a lot to say; if you haven't heard yet, tune into this crowd favorite! Like, share and subscribe. View the Podcast [] Listen to the Podcast [] Listen to the Podcast on Spotify [] [] [] President Trump's Dream Team: Who They Are and Why They Were Chosen There's something exciting in the air with only a few days left before the Presidential Inauguration. Americans are eager to see another Trump Administration and the promises made – kept – in short order. Our returning Commander-In-Chief seems poised to move quickly and effectively to save America from the failed policies of the last four years. He's tapped friends and colleagues to fill his cabinet, and a dream team is taking shape. As we look at some of his key picks, we're all ready to see our beloved nation become Great Again! "**Texas lawmakers will have $194.6 billion to spend for the next budget, comptroller projects,** " Texas Tribune's**Pooja Salhotra** -- "Texas is projected to have $194.6 billion available in general revenue to fund the business of the state over the 2026-2027 biennium, a slight decrease from the last budget cycle, Texas Comptroller **Glenn Hegar** said Monday in his [biennial revenue estimate](https://substack.com/redirect/cb1eb7fb-cf62-4ddb-995e-428455860995?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to state lawmakers and leaders.

The estimate comes one day before the Texas Legislature convenes on Tuesday for the start of the 2025 legislative session. The only thing lawmakers are constitutionally required to do during the 140-day session ending on June 2 is pass a balanced budget, one that spends no more than what is estimated to be available.

This year's estimate reflects a 1.1% drop from the amount of funds available during the 2024-25 biennium, when lawmakers were flush with a ["once-in-a-lifetime"](https://substack.com/redirect/382e3206-49c3-4205-8448-fc1794620063?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) cash balance, Hegar said. The drop is attributable to a smaller beginning balance compared to the previous budget cycle, not a drop in state revenue. Tax collections are projected to rise, and for the first time, the state's Economic Stabilization Fund -- also known as the rainy day fund -- is expected to exceed its constitutional cap. As a result, lawmakers have more money than is typical for general purpose spending.

Still, Hegar said lawmakers should make thoughtful financial decisions that focus on improving Texans' lives.

"Despite positive economic numbers, many of our residents continue to feel the higher cost of groceries, housing and other necessities. And the lingering impacts of persistently rising prices mean many are struggling to ensure a bright future for their children," Hegar said in a Monday statement accompanying the budget estimate.

The estimate includes an anticipated $176.4 billion in new revenue, most of which comes from sales and energy tax collections and can only be spent in the upcoming budget cycle. Sales tax collections are projected to increase by 9% from the previous two-year period, reaching $94.2 billion the next two years.

The estimated funds also includes $23.8 billion expected to be leftover from the 2024-25 biennium. Part of those leftover dollars include $4.5 billion that were earmarked for public education and education savings accounts but were not used because lawmakers [failed to reach a compromise](https://substack.com/redirect/3c48578a-b5a8-4a42-b49c-519839ad22e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to enact a voucher-like program.

This year, lawmakers are expected to prioritize passing a private school voucher program that uses taxpayer dollars to help pay for students' private schooling. Lt. Gov. **Dan Patrick** , who presides over the Texas Senate, has [called on](https://substack.com/redirect/700bc46b-43ca-43e7-8830-edc05b87024c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Gov. **Greg Abbott** to declare school vouchers an emergency item to give lawmakers a jumpstart on pushing the bill through the Legislature. Lawmakers cannot pass any bills within the first 60 days of the session unless it has been labeled an emergency item by the governor." ($5/mo or $50/yr or $199 lifetime) TOP NEWS "Texas lawmakers will have $194.6 billion to spend for the next budget, comptroller projects, " Texas Tribune'sPooja Salhotra -- "Texas is projected to have $194.6 billion available in general revenue to fund the business of the state over the 2026-2027 biennium, a slight decrease from the last budget cycle, Texas Comptroller Glenn Hegar said Monday in his to state lawmakers and leaders. The estimate comes one day before the Texas Legislature convenes on Tuesday for the start of the 2025 legislative session. The only thing lawmakers are constitutionally required to do during the 140-day session ending on June 2 is pass a balanced budget, one that spends no more than what is estimated to be available. This year's estimate reflects a 1.1% drop from the amount of funds available during the 2024-25 biennium, when lawmakers were flush with a cash balance, Hegar said. The drop is attributable to a smaller beginning balance compared to the previous budget cycle, not a drop in state revenue. Tax collections are projected to rise, and for the first time, the state's Economic Stabilization Fund -- also known as the rainy day fund -- is expected to exceed its constitutional cap. As a result, lawmakers have more money than is typical for general purpose spending. Still, Hegar said lawmakers should make thoughtful financial decisions that focus on improving Texans' lives. "Despite positive economic numbers, many of our residents continue to feel the higher cost of groceries, housing and other necessities. And the lingering impacts of persistently rising prices mean many are struggling to ensure a bright future for their children," Hegar said in a Monday statement accompanying the budget estimate. The estimate includes an anticipated $176.4 billion in new revenue, most of which comes from sales and energy tax collections and can only be spent in the upcoming budget cycle. Sales tax collections are projected to increase by 9% from the previous two-year period, reaching $94.2 billion the next two years. The estimated funds also includes $23.8 billion expected to be leftover from the 2024-25 biennium. Part of those leftover dollars include $4.5 billion that were earmarked for public education and education savings accounts but were not used because lawmakers to enact a voucher-like program. This year, lawmakers are expected to prioritize passing a private school voucher program that uses taxpayer dollars to help pay for students' private schooling. Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick , who presides over the Texas Senate, has Gov. Greg Abbott to declare school vouchers an emergency item to give lawmakers a jumpstart on pushing the bill through the Legislature. Lawmakers cannot pass any bills within the first 60 days of the session unless it has been labeled an emergency item by the governor." body:
The ATF is the only agency in charge of regulating the gun industry and enforcing our nation’s gun laws.
#

Friends -
We were already worried about what Donald Trump is going to do to weaken the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives—more commonly known as the ATF. He’s expected to pick a gun lobby extremist to lead it and will most likely make severe cuts to the agency’s annual budget.
**But now, we have an even bigger problem: House Republicans are trying to eliminate the ATF altogether.**
Rep. Lauren Boebert, one of the most extreme members of Congress, just introduced a bill to abolish the ATF. The ATF is the only agency in charge of regulating the gun industry and enforcing our nation’s gun laws. In particular, one of the agency’s main priorities is cracking down on illegal gun trafficking. If the ATF is dismantled, it will be a huge blow to public safety.
The GOP claims to be the party of “law and order,” and yet they’d rather sit in the pocket of the gun lobby than protect an agency that is working to keep our country safe from preventable gun violence.

This year’s estimate reflects a 1.1% drop from the amount of funds available during the 2024-25 biennium, when lawmakers were flush with a [“once-in-a-lifetime”](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.xjnMFfva-73dHOne5Rc0eCyDm7YZItPaA-BvJlf4tsAF0qdkJ7lMiKgRmtkAhyEZ8YFTh49XQ_EEyl8V7Ugvr98YH6C7silfC-xrsdYm0_qCZ0cI9UmfAzKJIZPiTvw7vc3hcA6e3wTyw7CVtL1jvIyQZB55cR6mPGpOZtSKgc4ikZ09pVnd_sSyHEqEhjtVe8YViJEI7sXJovBhQho7Jb3sbOmr4ueE4q5CszmfvJKYXG6AMjri0h9irctMTcJAEqssyOpv8XrMjtUcqXLBdkld-xENjLucj-V7RHIKIhcxhEyQavXthXl8qGG80xDHUlnjhY8L9AxkY6hsAlmp_q86vtNwQfmKRP5-_1mpQ8aIugOMq4DmoB0QYJkWTOa9tw-Hc-2CTrN4kE8bLxFtr3XGltwko6sDrjhIj_o6rQIOAYP_oOvPBTTBuPUVZKE7r_-V32ZAf35YRui3PVhQEw/4d5/hkblgk9jTlSHTGrGRPGINg/h10/h001.fnxGcLRCWld7kh9kENZsEoAtkGKsuYGcTVEjOjg6HHE) cash balance, Hegar said. The drop is attributable to a smaller beginning balance compared to the previous budget cycle, not a drop in state revenue. Tax collections are projected to rise, and for the first time, the state’s Economic Stabilization Fund — also known as the rainy day fund — is expected to exceed its constitutional cap. As a result, lawmakers have more money than is typical for general purpose spending.

Still, Hegar said lawmakers should make thoughtful financial decisions that focus on improving Texans’ lives.

“Despite positive economic numbers, many of our residents continue to feel the higher cost of groceries, housing and other necessities. And the lingering impacts of persistently rising prices mean many are struggling to ensure a bright future for their children,” Hegar said in a Monday statement accompanying the budget estimate.

($5/mo or $50/yr or $199 lifetime) | TOP NEWS “Texas lawmakers will have $194.6 billion to spend for the next budget, comptroller projects, ” Texas Tribune'sPooja Salhotra — “Texas is projected to have $194.6 billion available in general revenue to fund the business of the state over the 2026-2027 biennium, a slight decrease from the last budget cycle, Texas Comptroller Glenn Hegar said Monday in his to state lawmakers and leaders. The estimate comes one day before the Texas Legislature convenes on Tuesday for the start of the 2025 legislative session. The only thing lawmakers are constitutionally required to do during the 140-day session ending on June 2 is pass a balanced budget, one that spends no more than what is estimated to be available. This year’s estimate reflects a 1.1% drop from the amount of funds available during the 2024-25 biennium, when lawmakers were flush with a cash balance, Hegar said. The drop is attributable to a smaller beginning balance compared to the previous budget cycle, not a drop in state revenue. Tax collections are projected to rise, and for the first time, the state’s Economic Stabilization Fund — also known as the rainy day fund — is expected to exceed its constitutional cap. As a result, lawmakers have more money than is typical for general purpose spending. Still, Hegar said lawmakers should make thoughtful financial decisions that focus on improving Texans’ lives. “Despite positive economic numbers, many of our residents continue to feel the higher cost of groceries, housing and other necessities. And the lingering impacts of persistently rising prices mean many are struggling to ensure a bright future for their children,” Hegar said in a Monday statement accompanying the budget estimate. » » The estimate includes an anticipated $176.4 billion in new revenue, most of which comes from sales and energy tax collections and can only be spent in the upcoming budget cycle. Sales tax collections are projected to increase by 9% from the previous two-year period, reaching $94.2 billion the next two years. The estimated funds also includes $23.8 billion expected to be leftover from the 2024-25 biennium. Part of those leftover dollars include $4.5 billion that were earmarked for public education and education savings accounts but were not used because lawmakers to enact a voucher-like program. This year, lawmakers are expected to prioritize passing a private school voucher program that uses taxpayer dollars to help pay for students’ private schooling. Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick , who presides over the Texas Senate, has Gov. Greg Abbott to declare school vouchers an emergency item to give lawmakers a jumpstart on pushing the bill through the Legislature. body:
Trump is preparing to enter the White House with a Republican Congress and Cabinet stacked with billionaires ready to do his bidding.
---
Derek, In less than a week, Trump will be inaugurated as our next president. He will enter the White House with a Republican Congress and a Cabinet stacked with billionaires ready to do his bidding. We know that’s not the outcome we fought so hard for last year. If you’re feeling frustrated and worried about what’s to come, you’re certainly not alone. But while it might be tempting to tune out entirely right now, the truth is that there is nothing Trump and his allies would love more than to enact their Project 2025 agenda while we all just sit by and watch. They’d love to see Democrats give up. And that’s exactly what we can’t afford to do — not with so much on the line. Since Election Day, thousands of Democrats have committed to staying in the fight, and have made contributions to help us build the strongest possible Party. Today, they need you to join them. name: Andrew Yang
subject: The Fires of LA
body:
It has been devastating for all of us seeing wildfires consume thousands of homes, businesses and schools in Southern California these past days. | |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=c253e58d08&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=5487cffdb2&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
| When it feels like the world is on fire, sometimes it is. It has been devastating for all of us seeing wildfires consume thousands of homes, businesses and schools in Southern California these past days. The loss of life and memories is incalculable. This may be the most destructive natural disaster in our lifetimes. It hurts on multiple levels. I have friends who have been burnt out of house and home. I’ve been to that part of the country many, many times and it’s no exaggeration to say it’s one of the most beautiful parts of the United States. In many places you can see the ocean and feel what has drawn people there for generations. Now, those communities are ashes and husks and thousands of families are not sure whether they will ever return. There’s both a sense of helplessness and frustration that the wildfires could not be better contained. Seeing families in despair that their homes could not be saved is heartbreaking in part because it feels like it could have been different. This is not an earthquake, where you could say, “Well, what could you do?” Instead, it seems that some of this destruction was avoidable and preventable. America being what it is in 2025, this disaster has become politicized. Climate change certainly played a role, intensifying the vulnerability of the region and the intensity of the winds. Donald Trump is crowing about blue state failure. California politicians are looking to shift blame and responsibility. Gavin Newsom is looking at Karen Bass, who will be an easy target given that she was abroad when the fires intensified. To be sure, these fires will have profound political implications. I’ve spoken to multiple Californians who are furious at what they see as profound incompetence by a clumsy, bureaucratic government that failed to protect them when it mattered most. There will be a movement in the days to come calling for change and accountability. But the impact is felt by all of us because of the scale of the destruction and the human toll. One of our cultural centers has partially burnt to the ground, 24 people have died and thousands are dislocated. If the people of Los Angeles aren’t safe from a fire, who can consider their way of life secure? That’s not a question we have been forced to ask ourselves, but it’s now with us more and more. We are all set to become firefighters in one way or another. I wish it were different. To donate to shelters for the dislocated, you can do so [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=43b288b1ba&e=0f227c2ae3) with the Los Angeles Chapter of the American Red Cross.
---
| **
Andrew Yang**
Co-Chair, Forward Party

| | Dear Friend in Faith, Please -- for the sake of all our families -- take it from me as someone who's lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life...You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace. But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue's Clues_...

[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=ded0d3215544414abf71917a05f6e292&_e=MezHfgOcvwlEDcXrRBCO9Gc9WKjD0s0IPWIPck6utHUS8USy9wOOecow4uah1K83f5fmz2mJtMxembGxwTCm9WVbdm7eTunbRLUFtDHAXCAHwl-xMy1PAjaZUeqGzfZ4arJIpzExa5yeYs5D6poCI5LTCGBL_elBrMQKMvxdGabuEzR3CyS-_mvEA42d2TJLnom6N38SgETNPlwhebtwdWVmywJ0zUMt1pK1dmreX8wrsS6dW-gwX97I8b8O3p9u5Qikfw_DoYw5oqcWscUtefsWw43P2Oxpgv4Fa9rInO4_LT_uFs-TAipn96DeQ3jXSsmRNUtxVpe8d_hgw4W27FJHrh2d8oopywPCTxxqvycFBUpULXMLpUDVPrfzZ8PE)

| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to "educate" YOU about your "old-fashioned" and "mean" ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. [**Today, I'm inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great**.](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=ded0d3215544414abf71917a05f6e292&_e=MezHfgOcvwlEDcXrRBCO9Gc9WKjD0s0IPWIPck6utHUS8USy9wOOecow4uah1K83f5fmz2mJtMxembGxwTCm9WVbdm7eTunbRLUFtDHAXCAHwl-xMy1PAjaZUeqGzfZ4arJIpzExa5yeYs5D6poCI5LTCGBL_elBrMQKMvxdGabuEzR3CyS-_mvEA42d2TJLnom6N38SgETNPlwhebtwdWVmywJ0zUMt1pK1dmreX8zmvMy819yONH6qRlT4Yn3WutHLPhUD5Y--a4N1czccG6A5DQfmibExljaq-AAaiSnqIaaXVtli2VcsrYZPHqX8W2U_t7MNTo-du0Lm6HToUnhR6KUH6HgiaB12R4Fzxm9jjVAi7091S3ToGp9ivn3f)Introducing: _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I'm making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you've seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we've already countered those awful "Drag Queen Story Hours" the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic "Story Hours" of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It's encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we're working to have that same impact in television.
---
>>Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we've already completed the first ten character-building episodes of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_!We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone -- including folks just like you -- who worked so hard to get us that far.But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we're making the first 5 episodes of Season 1 of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE to everyone on YouTube. That's the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can't get the word out. And the left will try to bury _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 -- and we need to raise the funds in this first quarter of 2025.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $125,000 per episode.**_

| | Good Friends, Happy New Year! We hope this invitation finds you well. The **New Pennsylvania Project** and **Why Courts Matter - PA** are excited to continue our vital work providing civic education to our centered communities. As a voting rights organization, our mission is to provide current, accurate, and accessible information about the importance of voting in every election. We’d love for you to join us for our **Why Courts Matter- 201 Virtual Townhall:** **Event Details:****Date:** Thursday, January 30, 2025**Time:** 6:30 – 8:00 PM (via Zoom) **Speakers:** Kadida Kenner, Founding CEO, New Pennsylvania Project **Why Attend?****
** This townhall will focus on the importance of our state and federal courts, how they impact our daily lives, and how to engage in the state judicial election process, and protect the independence of our federal courts. Specifically, we will discuss:
* How federal judges are appointed and confirmed for a lifetime, and their long-term impact on our daily lives.
* The **2025 Pennsylvania judicial elections** (including retention elections for three seats on the PA Supreme Court).**

**Your participation in state judicial elections can make a difference.** A civically engaged electorate is crucial to ensuring fair and independent courts.

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for re-election so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in the United States Senate. The Radical Left has him circled as a prime target to defeat in the 2026 Midterm Elections. Can he count on your support? _

# Devotional to accompany Episode #48 "Deception is at Hand"
1\. What stood out to you the most from Rachel's message today about deception?
2\. Can you think of a time when you felt God gave you discernment for a specific situation?
3\. How can we support each other to stay grounded in truth?
4\. What does having the 'mind of Christ' mean to you personally?
5\. How do _you_ discern between truth and deception in today's digital age?
6\. What's one step you can take this week to deepen your relationship with God? **Life Application Suggestions:** This week, commit to spending at least 15 minutes each day reading and meditating on scripture. Ask God to reveal His truth to you and to increase your discernment in all areas of your life.
**Key Takeaways from the Episode:** Deception is prevalent and is only going to increase with A.I.! We must be vigilant in guarding against it.
Daily engagement with scripture is crucial for spiritual discernment.
Asking God for discernment is essential in recognizing truth.
Believers have the privilege of claiming the mind of Christ.
Renewing our minds with God's Word transforms our lives and perspectives.
**Ending Prayer** Lord, we thank You for the insights and wisdom you give us. As we go forth, help us to apply what we've learned and to remain steadfast in Your truth. Grant us discernment to recognize deception and the courage to stand firm in our faith. May Your Word continue to renew our minds and guide our actions. In Jesus' name, we pray. Amen. **Watch today's episode here:**

name: The Babylon Bee
subject: Trump, Elon, & The Bee
body:
Turns out the American people care deeply about two things: the cost of bacon and a censorship regime that silences its critics.

| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e0351a959b4a4730b1395599faa1aa19&_e=uj3yOFB2UDtJ-uQQveTRergDOIt1zBGxr5F7SpyxQHt-iiyO324ySH_w80yR12u3VTPUO_jQeNr2W6-B8lj48SAuHOrCEGuIHxjlhNzSz06pkrF-rrcDE5V536mbfXOZtGRLXPMgFWp9VOYs3otY_0gN1JJKkqCY_epDHRKCb7yOoDtw24PNpSBkkeGLADpCnxsvxv0RQt0TXl5hC9sPKGy_lqNfl7JHK4lMiGlyaH_WWPeYOOGjlnYQRtrx4VfF-yxmZ5jbxuBnQvUdWlIN7g%3D%3D)
---
|
---
Friend, Voters have made their voices heard.Turns out the American people care deeply about two things: the cost of bacon and a censorship regime that silences its critics. Friend,

With the trial of my life set to begin, President Donald J. Trump just

_“SAVE RUDY!”_

On Thursday, I will be on trial – _without a jury, mind you_ – to
determine whether or not I still have a home to live in. It’s a
trial to save my home and a trial to fight for my basic freedoms and
rights.

_But more than that, our nation’s very system of justice will also
be on trial._

If the Radical Left Democrats can get away with destroying me in a

Being engaged locally is vital because decisions made at the local level often have the most direct impact on our daily lives.

| MassGOP Applauds Republican Caucus for Comprehensive Plan to Address Migrant Crisis
---
---
| Boston, MA-- The Massachusetts Republican Party today praised Senate Minority Leader Bruce Tarr (R-Gloucester) and House Minority Leader Brad Jones (R-North Reading) for their bold leadership in unveiling a [comprehensive plan to address the ongoing migrant crisis](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001hNI6Y3qYEa8_m8mwBx1pkp7gKCVNA6lbspf2ZQg8HOWrotCFckMdV2YZIzKbrvmDtsgaFYq0eEW_L4wlGBL0Yz3X3XuoUIHTjYS0BSjkoDlbwBp5CkX1P9UJz7m25omNKBVU4Kgfm-QJYNjO7qGZNVB19yYCZCuUgUfpC0Fusd_TXUFMSJCtcRmFov4evLSwn92P8vzbzufc0QwkUFPJjHy2E1K4kQeDxDHmF0nCe-odnNaAUBptOw==&c=VH0OL1zbVe3tQqAWqX_Dwn_g8YzkEvKIy8gzaZRHfYCEQsOm68cMyg==&ch=y_0531hQNLhsA4ncsNyx1sZEXwgJxLKeO41beR8B2AnOs9jwU710IQ==). The plan, presented at the State House, includes critical administrative reforms and legislative proposals aimed at ensuring transparency, accountability, public safety, and fiscal responsibility.
"House and Senate Republicans have demonstrated the leadership our state so desperately needs in tackling the migrant crisis," said MassGOP Chair Amy Carnevale. "Their detailed, common-sense plan provides a clear path forward to restore stability to our emergency shelter system, protect public safety, and safeguard taxpayer dollars. This is the kind of governance Massachusetts residents deserve."
The proposed reforms, grounded in findings from the November 2024 Special Commission on Emergency Housing Assistance Programs, address the unsustainable costs and public safety challenges of the current system. Key provisions include:

* Monthly Legislative Briefings and Cost Accounting: Establish regular, transparent briefings to provide updates on the migrant crisis response and its impact on the state.
* Monthly Cost Accounting: Require a detailed, monthly accounting of all expenditures related to the migrant crisis to ensure full transparency.
* Sustainability Plan From Governor's Administration: Develop a plan to scale down the emergency shelter program and transition to a more sustainable model as the crisis evolves.
* Comprehensive Audit of the Migrant Shelter System by the Auditor: Conduct a thorough audit of all costs associated with the state's response to the migrant crisis to ensure fiscal responsibility and accountability.
* Amend the Right to Shelter Law: Modify the Right to Shelter law to require individuals seeking shelter to demonstrate lawful presence in Massachusetts for at least one year, excluding victims of domestic violence and those displaced by natural disasters.
* Limit Shelter Stays: Implement a six-month limit on shelter stays to ensure fair access to resources and encourage individuals to transition to longer-term solutions.
* Prevent Violent Actors from Re-entering the Shelter System: Establish clear protocols to prevent individuals who have engaged in violent behavior from re-entering the shelter system.
* Honor Ice Detainers for Violent Offenders: Allow law enforcement and the courts to honor ICE detainers for individuals with violent criminal backgrounds, ensuring the safety of all residents.
* Competitive Bidding for Crisis Response Contracts: Require a competitive bidding process for all elements of the migrant crisis response, promoting fairness and efficiency in the allocation of state funds.
* Creation of Officer of Inspector General (OIG) Unit: Establish an OIG unit specifically tasked with overseeing the migrant crisis response to ensure accountability, transparency, and adherence to state laws.

"Massachusetts is facing a crisis that requires immediate action and thoughtful reform," said Carnevale. "This plan reflects the values of our party--fairness, responsibility, and a commitment to the safety and well-being of all residents."
The MassGOP urges Governor Healey and Democratic legislators to prioritize these reforms and work collaboratively with Republicans to implement solutions that will benefit communities across the Commonwealth.

clean_body: | | | | | | | == | MassGOP Applauds Republican Caucus for Comprehensive Plan to Address Migrant Crisis | Boston, MA-- The Massachusetts Republican Party today praised Senate Minority Leader Bruce Tarr (R-Gloucester) and House Minority Leader Brad Jones (R-North Reading) for their bold leadership in unveiling a ==. The plan, presented at the State House, includes critical administrative reforms and legislative proposals aimed at ensuring transparency, accountability, public safety, and fiscal responsibility. "House and Senate Republicans have demonstrated the leadership our state so desperately needs in tackling the migrant crisis," said MassGOP Chair Amy Carnevale. "Their detailed, common-sense plan provides a clear path forward to restore stability to our emergency shelter system, protect public safety, and safeguard taxpayer dollars. This is the kind of governance Massachusetts residents deserve." The proposed reforms, grounded in findings from the November 2024 Special Commission on Emergency Housing Assistance Programs, address the unsustainable costs and public safety challenges of the current system. Key provisions include: Monthly Legislative Briefings and Cost Accounting: Establish regular, transparent briefings to provide updates on the migrant crisis response and its impact on the state. Monthly Cost Accounting: Require a detailed, monthly accounting of all expenditures related to the migrant crisis to ensure full transparency. Sustainability Plan From Governor's Administration: Develop a plan to scale down the emergency shelter program and transition to a more sustainable model as the crisis evolves. Comprehensive Audit of the Migrant Shelter System by the Auditor: Conduct a thorough audit of all costs associated with the state's response to the migrant crisis to ensure fiscal responsibility and accountability. Amend the Right to Shelter Law: Modify the Right to Shelter law to require individuals seeking shelter to demonstrate lawful presence in Massachusetts for at least one year, excluding victims of domestic violence and those displaced by natural disasters. Limit Shelter Stays: Implement a six-month limit on shelter stays to ensure fair access to resources and encourage individuals to transition to longer-term solutions. Prevent Violent Actors from Re-entering the Shelter System: Establish clear protocols to prevent individuals who have engaged in violent behavior from re-entering the shelter system. Honor Ice Detainers for Violent Offenders: Allow law enforcement and the courts to honor ICE detainers for individuals with violent criminal backgrounds, ensuring the safety of all residents. Competitive Bidding for Crisis Response Contracts: Require a competitive bidding process for all elements of the migrant crisis response, promoting fairness and efficiency in the allocation of state funds. Creation of Officer of Inspector General (OIG) Unit: Establish an OIG unit specifically tasked with overseeing the migrant crisis response to ensure accountability, transparency, and adherence to state laws. "Massachusetts is facing a crisis that requires immediate action and thoughtful reform," said Carnevale. "This plan reflects the values of our party--fairness, responsibility, and a commitment to the safety and well-being of all residents." The MassGOP urges Governor Healey and Democratic legislators to prioritize these reforms and work collaboratively with Republicans to implement solutions that will benefit communities across the Commonwealth. | | | | | == | MassGOP | == | == == | | | | Massachusetts Republican Party | 85 Merrimac Street, Suite 505 | Boston, MA 02114 US | | | | | | | | |

As you read this I am en route to LA County with Humanity First USA to support victims of the LA fires. I have worked with Humanity First for decades, first deploying with them in 2005 to support those devastated by Hurricane Katrina. Over the years I've traveled with Humanity First to Mali to help build schools and hospitals, to Guatemala to help expand a hospital, to Turkey for earthquake relief, and to Hawaii after the Lahaina fires. I consider it a privilege to continue to work with Humanity First now twenty years later in 2025. And, I invite you to donate to Humanity First USA to help us provide practical aid, supplies, and water to people suffering on the ground.
[Donate to Humanity First USA](https://substack.com/redirect/8bc5c13e-0d9f-40b4-9a0b-63b08ba1827d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Experts estimate that these fires have caused at least $50 billion in damages. I am traveling to LA to provide legal support because I know what is about to happen--if it hasn't already begun.
A quick story to explain.
Days after the 2023 Lahaina fires I flew to Hawaii to provide pro bono legal aid to fire victims. We navigated everything from home insurance and business contracts, to recovering legal documents, to managing immigration status, and more. In total I supported about 50 families, indeed a humbling experience. But one constant theme with each client left me shocked and angry.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/caad5e15-4aa7-4842-b0fc-e062fcabecc3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Our Humanity First USA Legal and Logistical Assistant tent, where we were able to meet with and assist hundreds of families afflicted by the Lahaina fires.
Even before most had the chance to return to their homes to assess the extent of the damage and destruction, private equity vultures had begun to relentlessly call, harass, and pressure them to accept pennies on the dollar for their destroyed homes. Vultures exploiting people's desperation and depression. I worked with these families to ensure they understood their rights, protections, and options before making any decisions out of confusion or devastation. But these vultures were relentless.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9c7d57d9-be5e-4271-9f9c-b7ed8ba48bb0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Navigating through the steps a local family would need to take to ensure their insurance paperwork was filed timely and properly.
Thus, one big reason I am en route to the epicenter of the LA fires is that I suspect vulture capitalists will make the same attempts to exploit our already devastated neighbors, and I want to do my part to protect their humanity.
My takeaway from Lahaina was that we need better protections for people suffering under these disasters. People who have suddenly lost everything are not in a state of balance or security, and certainly not in a position to make life altering financial decisions. Too few protections exist right now, if any at all. That must change--because this injustice is not sustainable.
As a final note, I will do my best to provide updates while out here, but forgive me if you do not receive your daily updated post on _Let 's Address This_. I and my colleague attorneys will be doing our best to protect the rights and humanity of those we can. You can support our efforts by donating to Humanity First USA, a highly respected 501(c)3. Your donation is tax deductible as it counts as a charitable contribution.
[Donate to Humanity First USA](https://substack.com/redirect/8bc5c13e-0d9f-40b4-9a0b-63b08ba1827d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9f48108d-3201-40b2-b33d-80c576b01502?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
(L) Qasim Rashid at 23 years old in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. (R) Qasim Rashid at 41 years old in Lahaina, Hawaii.
Our nation becomes the more perfect Union it was meant to become when we act to recognize each other's humanity. Thank you all for your continued trust, donations, support, and partnership to elevate each other's humanity. The absurdity of a tech giant deplatforming a satirical site woke a sleeping giant.Enter Elon Musk. Elon purchased Twitter and joined The Babylon Bee in starting a revolution that catapulted free speech to the election's frontlines. But, before millions gave censorship the middle finger at the polls,it was our subscribers who stood strong against the left 's suppression of thought.Without our Babylon Bee subscribers, I firmly believe that FREE SPEECH wouldn 't have become such a major issue this election. The left ignorantly believes that our subscribers -- Americans who like to laugh at the absurdity of our world -- are " fringe." President Trump's landslide victory proves that there are MILLIONS of people just like our subscribers -- including unlikely Republican voters like Elon Musk and Joe Rogan -- who believe that free speech is a critical pillar of our democracy. leave you with this, a photo of two handsome men who love humor, the First Amendment, and America. Thanks for supporting free speech. We 'll never give up the fight.Seth Dillon CEO, The Babylon Bee Pronouns: Bee and Beeself | Copyright(C) 2023 Babylon Bee, All rights reserved. Fellow Christian, This is one of the most serious, and most disturbing, threats to Christians in public life . . . yet most Christians in America don't know anything about it! **The last, and strongest, line of legal defense for Christians in the United States may soon be destroyed by ideological activists, with a regulatory change being considered in ALL 50 states.** That could make critical legal victories for Americans of faith--like protection of **personal prayer** without getting fired, protection of **moral conscience** so you can't be forced to dispense abortion-inducing drugs, and even protection of students forming a **Christian student club** --IMPOSSIBLE to pursue . . . . . . and leave Christians and Americans of faith, alongside religious ministries, nonprofits, and schools, without ANY legal defense when they wrongly and unconstitutionally face threats or punishment for their biblical values! **Fellow Christian, Christian Legal Society, a fellowship, ministry, and legal defense organization since 1961, is leading the fight to protect Christian attorneys and all Americans of faith, state by state.** _**[_**Against a well-organized, well-funded opposition, we're counting on the support of generous Americans of faith like you to stand with us. Would you consider a gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, or even $500 to help support Christian Legal Society in this critical work?**_](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=3223458ce4ff4d2f968687c4e9cc2af3&_e=cZBflwIUVYVJG-DDka_EjUo0UTqNL5rDNXxvZEbFdzOg0tXKmmNZKV88A882DCzExOAES33ElIAAVqX2Qd6PJ1ooSfgmG8ueow_4BuwPk5e0cUL7WZML-V0RHOvrfFAGOa2H391O0DeDJTlgJX3fHbttb9su6BNEmIYUBoohI_7km0GhlZeH03mJU0GjuoXJYxcKbJ8p_uawLecgJWiT6GKdJM_7rQkayruXnOSvTPAyIQqkNLB860C7RUHaLlO-dr6KzEznC3QaWJ-mXFh7R-Kj5Bw0IOLmPnr0DGaax_m74016bO9kjUggbwDrcUHD)**_

For those who don't work in law offices, the rule change I'm discussing may sound boring or unremarkable: it's known as Model Rule 8.4(g) from the American Bar Association. **But its impact has devastating real-world consequences for Christian attorneys and all Americans of faith, as the silencing and punishment of Christian attorneys --and the faithful Americans they would otherwise defend--seems to be the sole goal of this rule change.** Without any examples of why it's needed . . . without any response to the 400+ comments and letters of concern submitted by all attorneys concerned with free speech, the American Bar Association offered no response to rightful concerns that radical activists could use this to:
* **discourage or punish attorneys** from sharing political, social, or religious viewpoints that are outside the current political orthodoxy (today, that's typically defined as "progressive" or "Woke");

* **stop attorneys from volunteering at their churches,** sitting on church boards, or serving schools they've gone to, if those schools are Christian or otherwise religious;

* **prevent attorneys from serving in Christian ministries** , no matter how much good work those ministries do in their communities; and

* **put an end to Christian attorneys doing pro bono work** **to defend religious freedom** on behalf of Christian ministries, nonprofits, or schools that proudly proclaim their commitment to biblical values!

**Fellow Christian, there is still time to stop this rule from taking root in America . . . but it requires a 50-state strategy and a major investment of time, talent, and legal work.** Christian Legal Society has led the charge on this important issue since it was first raised in 2015. But to make sure we WIN this fight--and preserve religious freedom and protection for Christian attorneys and, by extension, all Americans of faith--I'm counting on your support. _**[_**Can I count on your generous gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, or even $500 to help Christian Legal Society save these critical protections for Christian attorneys . . . and every ministry, nonprofit, or believer that those same attorneys would defend?**_](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=3223458ce4ff4d2f968687c4e9cc2af3&_e=cZBflwIUVYVJG-DDka_EjUo0UTqNL5rDNXxvZEbFdzOg0tXKmmNZKV88A882DCzExOAES33ElIAAVqX2Qd6PJ1ooSfgmG8ueow_4BuwPk5e0cUL7WZML-V0RHOvrfFAGOa2H391O0DeDJTlgJX3fHbttb9su6BNEmIYUBoohI_6Sy8g9Bly2II1Ind9wpoJvSvzDYUywVotMv5V6DCYWzrK3OioBSotTkt02VhnqFZmCcSVxRnFkCg5qYfAJHjiUquLmgsaatVsPZ8L6QHW-c9K8RjUdRUjk0QioMon4z9A1LS7Wd98-mxk2zzOpRAJb)**_

Since 1961, Christian Legal Society has been a fellowship of Christians dedicated to serving Jesus Christ through the practice and study of law, the defense of religious freedom and life, and the provision of legal aid to the needy. And for nearly 50 years, Christian Legal Society's Center for Law & Religious Freedom, which is spearheading the response to this proposed rule change, has defended and advanced all Americans' inalienable rights to religious freedom and life in the public square. **No other organization is leading the charge to defend Christian attorneys and all Americans of faith on this critical issue like Christian Legal Society.** _**[That's why I encourage you--and hope--that you'll make your most generous gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, or more right now to help Christian Legal Society WIN critical victories in the battles still to come.](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=3223458ce4ff4d2f968687c4e9cc2af3&_e=cZBflwIUVYVJG-DDka_EjUo0UTqNL5rDNXxvZEbFdzOg0tXKmmNZKV88A882DCzExOAES33ElIAAVqX2Qd6PJ1ooSfgmG8ueow_4BuwPk5e0cUL7WZML-V0RHOvrfFAGOa2H391O0DeDJTlgJX3fHbttb9su6BNEmIYUBoohI_7nUUb7F8L4wykQl6UdZhlypO5HQMHtptIvF5aoWzAcfTFvxa2Uq99pZwmdA3PGYNEknIGbmLBwSSyXlip6saCNTim_8mG6eaa1yOFHz9M9UhXYrC918U_3vWiIFp7OPvP4Pfy_pl_tum_dFxViuUz4)**_ Thank you for your support and for your prayerful consideration. clean_body: Why we need Christian attorneys| | | Fellow Christian, This is one of the most serious, and most disturbing, threats to Christians in public life . . . yet most Christians in America don't know anything about it! The last, and strongest, line of legal defense for Christians in the United States may soon be destroyed by ideological activists, with a regulatory change being considered in ALL 50 states. That could make critical legal victories for Americans of faith--like protection of personal prayer without getting fired, protection of moral conscience so you can't be forced to dispense abortion-inducing drugs, and even protection of students forming a Christian student club --IMPOSSIBLE to pursue . . . . . . and leave Christians and Americans of faith, alongside religious ministries, nonprofits, and schools, without ANY legal defense when they wrongly and unconstitutionally face threats or punishment for their biblical values! Fellow Christian, Christian Legal Society, a fellowship, ministry, and legal defense organization since 1961, is leading the fight to protect Christian attorneys and all Americans of faith, state by state. For those who don't work in law offices, the rule change I'm discussing may sound boring or unremarkable: it's known as Model Rule 8.4(g) from the American Bar Association. But its impact has devastating real-world consequences for Christian attorneys and all Americans of faith, as the silencing and punishment of Christian attorneys --and the faithful Americans they would otherwise defend--seems to be the sole goal of this rule change. Without any examples of why it's needed . . . without any response to the 400+ comments and letters of concern submitted by all attorneys concerned with free speech, the American Bar Association offered no response to rightful concerns that radical activists could use this to: discourage or punish attorneys from sharing political, social, or religious viewpoints that are outside the current political orthodoxy (today, that's typically defined as "progressive" or "Woke"); stop attorneys from volunteering at their churches, sitting on church boards, or serving schools they've gone to, if those schools are Christian or otherwise religious; prevent attorneys from serving in Christian ministries , no matter how much good work those ministries do in their communities; and put an end to Christian attorneys doing pro bono work to defend religious freedom on behalf of Christian ministries, nonprofits, or schools that proudly proclaim their commitment to biblical values! Fellow Christian, there is still time to stop this rule from taking root in America . . . but it requires a 50-state strategy and a major investment of time, talent, and legal work. Christian Legal Society has led the charge on this important issue since it was first raised in 2015. But to make sure we WIN this fight--and preserve religious freedom and protection for Christian attorneys and, by extension, all Americans of faith--I'm counting on your support. Since 1961, Christian Legal Society has been a fellowship of Christians dedicated to serving Jesus Christ through the practice and study of law, the defense of religious freedom and life, and the provision of legal aid to the needy. And for nearly 50 years, Christian Legal Society's Center for Law & Religious Freedom, which is spearheading the response to this proposed rule change, has defended and advanced all Americans' inalienable rights to religious freedom and life in the public square. No other organization is leading the charge to defend Christian attorneys and all Americans of faith on this critical issue like Christian Legal Society. Thank you for your support and for your prayerful consideration. David Nammo Executive Director & CEO Christian Legal Society Christian Legal Society P.O. Box 7712 McLean, VA 22106-7712

Trump just said two powerful words for the entire nation to hear... “SAVE RUDY!” On Thursday, I will be on trial – without a jury, mind you – to determine whether or not I still have a home to live in. If the Radical Left Democrats can get away with destroying me in a weaponized court without a jury – and possibly imprisoning me – solely because I served as President Trump’s lawyer, then the rule of law is DEAD in America. Just last week, a bloodthirsty left-wing judge threatened me with contempt and imprisonment if I didn’t recite her dictated false version of covered-up massive evidence of voter fraud. I had a choice to make: I could recite the state-sanctioned propaganda like an obedient little dog and be rewarded with a pat on the head. Or, I could have the courage to stand for what I know to be true. When I remind you of this Bible verse, you’ll know exactly which choice I made: "For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? " (Mark 8:36) You see, I refuse to give up on America. That’s why I’m going on trial to fight to save my home, my liberty, and our Republic. Are YOU with me? subject: Donate to support care workers during the Los Angeles wildfires
body:
The devastating wildfires in Los Angeles have left entire communities in crisis.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100394138/522619063/664783965?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZDk5M2MwZS1hYmQyLWVmMTEtODhkMC0wMDIyNDgyYTlkOTIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vv08E7mGSf4acMiy2gKA-H-dU6Wt4bhxByYWkAAPSFU=&emci=3cf4f91a-96d2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=4d993c0e-abd2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=864787)
Hi Peter,
The devastating wildfires in Los Angeles have left entire communities in crisis—destroying more than 12,000 homes, schools, and places of safety and stability.
**For domestic workers and care workers — more than half of whom are Black, Latinx, and immigrant women nationwide — the wildfires have made an already fragile care safety net more likely to collapse.**
Now, many of them are struggling to meet their basic needs while they try to get to the other side of this unthinkable tragedy.
We need your help. **[**_Can you make a donation to the 'We Care: Domestic Worker Relief Fund' and support domestic workers and care workers during the Los Angeles wildfires crisis?_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100394139/522619064/1451153036?refcode=EM_CS_CIA_FR_1_2025-01-14_WIF_CWK_ES-15965&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZDk5M2MwZS1hYmQyLWVmMTEtODhkMC0wMDIyNDgyYTlkOTIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vv08E7mGSf4acMiy2gKA-H-dU6Wt4bhxByYWkAAPSFU=) Your donation will be used to support trusted Los Angeles affiliates of our allied organization, the National Domestic Workers Alliance, **including CHIRLA, Instituto Educación Popular (IDEPSCA), and Pilipino Workers Center, that are providing:
* **Emergency financial assistance** for housing, food, and medical care.
* **Basic supplies** to help care workers and their families rebuild their lives.
* **Long-term recovery support** to ensure they can get back on their feet.

**********__[RUSH A DONATION TODAY](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100394140/522619065/1451153036?refcode=EM_CS_CIA_FR_1_2025-01-14_WIF_CWK_ES-15965&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZDk5M2MwZS1hYmQyLWVmMTEtODhkMC0wMDIyNDgyYTlkOTIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vv08E7mGSf4acMiy2gKA-H-dU6Wt4bhxByYWkAAPSFU=)__**********
**Care workers and domestic workers are disproportionately impacted and often overlooked in recovery efforts due to a lack of worker protections, low wages, and systemic inequities tied to gender, race, and immigration status.**
As they face the aftermath of the LA wildfires, **many are struggling to recover without access to safety nets like paid leave or unemployment insurance.** **[**_Your donation can provide critical relief to help them rebuild their lives_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100394141/522619066/1451153036?refcode=EM_CS_CIA_FR_1_2025-01-14_WIF_CWK_ES-15965&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZDk5M2MwZS1hYmQyLWVmMTEtODhkMC0wMDIyNDgyYTlkOTIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vv08E7mGSf4acMiy2gKA-H-dU6Wt4bhxByYWkAAPSFU=).**
**********__[RUSH A DONATION TODAY](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100394142/522619067/1451153036?refcode=EM_CS_CIA_FR_1_2025-01-14_WIF_CWK_ES-15965&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZDk5M2MwZS1hYmQyLWVmMTEtODhkMC0wMDIyNDgyYTlkOTIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vv08E7mGSf4acMiy2gKA-H-dU6Wt4bhxByYWkAAPSFU=)__**********
We understand that many of us are feeling the strain of rising costs and inflation. But for care workers and domestic workers in Los Angeles, the wildfires have created an even greater crisis. **These essential workers, who already face significant challenges, urgently need support to recover and rebuild.**
These are the workers who care for our loved ones, clean our homes, and support our communities. Yet, as workers in private homes, they’re **some of the first to lose income during times of crisis and some of the last to receive aid.**
[**_Every dollar you donate makes a difference. Your contribution will go directly toward on-the-ground organizations that are providing emergency assistance, basic supplies, and long-term recovery support to domestic workers and their families._**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100394143/522619068/1451153036?refcode=EM_CS_CIA_FR_1_2025-01-14_WIF_CWK_ES-15965&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZDk5M2MwZS1hYmQyLWVmMTEtODhkMC0wMDIyNDgyYTlkOTIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vv08E7mGSf4acMiy2gKA-H-dU6Wt4bhxByYWkAAPSFU=)
**********__[RUSH A DONATION TODAY](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100394144/522619069/1451153036?refcode=EM_CS_CIA_FR_1_2025-01-14_WIF_CWK_ES-15965&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZDk5M2MwZS1hYmQyLWVmMTEtODhkMC0wMDIyNDgyYTlkOTIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vv08E7mGSf4acMiy2gKA-H-dU6Wt4bhxByYWkAAPSFU=)__**********
We’ve seen it time and time again: when we come together, we can overcome even the most difficult challenges. **[**_Domestic workers and care workers have always been there for us—now it’s our turn to be there for them._**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100394145/522619070/1451153036?refcode=EM_CS_CIA_FR_1_2025-01-14_WIF_CWK_ES-15965&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZDk5M2MwZS1hYmQyLWVmMTEtODhkMC0wMDIyNDgyYTlkOTIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vv08E7mGSf4acMiy2gKA-H-dU6Wt4bhxByYWkAAPSFU=)**
In solidarity,
Care in Action

clean_body: The devastating wildfires in Los Angeles have left entire communities in crisis. Hi Peter, The devastating wildfires in Los Angeles have left entire communities in crisis—destroying more than 12,000 homes, schools, and places of safety and stability. For domestic workers and care workers — more than half of whom are Black, Latinx, and immigrant women nationwide — the wildfires have made an already fragile care safety net more likely to collapse. Now, many of them are struggling to meet their basic needs while they try to get to the other side of this unthinkable tragedy. We need your help. = Your donation will be used to support trusted Los Angeles affiliates of our allied organization, the National Domestic Workers Alliance, including CHIRLA, Instituto Educación Popular (IDEPSCA), and Pilipino Workers Center, that are providing: Emergency financial assistance for housing, food, and medical care. Basic supplies to help care workers and their families rebuild their lives. Long-term recovery support to ensure they can get back on their feet. ******=****** Care workers and domestic workers are disproportionately impacted and often overlooked in recovery efforts due to a lack of worker protections, low wages, and systemic inequities tied to gender, race, and immigration status. As they face the aftermath of the LA wildfires, many are struggling to recover without access to safety nets like paid leave or unemployment insurance. =. ******=****** We understand that many of us are feeling the strain of rising costs and inflation. But for care workers and domestic workers in Los Angeles, the wildfires have created an even greater crisis. These essential workers, who already face significant challenges, urgently need support to recover and rebuild. These are the workers who care for our loved ones, clean our homes, and support our communities. Yet, as workers in private homes, they’re some of the first to lose income during times of crisis and some of the last to receive aid. = ******=****** We’ve seen it time and time again: when we come together, we can overcome even the most difficult challenges. =** In solidarity, Care in Action

Fellow Patriot,
---
With the trial of my life set to begin, President Donald J. Trump just said two powerful words for the entire nation to hear...
---
**_“SAVE RUDY!”_**
---
On Thursday, I will be on trial – __without_ a jury, mind you_ – to determine whether or not I still have a home to live in. It’s a trial to save my home and a trial to fight for my basic freedoms and rights.
---
_But more than that, our nation’s very system of justice will also be on trial._
---
If the Radical Left Democrats can get away with destroying me in a weaponized court without a jury – and possibly imprisoning me – solely because I served as President Trump’s lawyer, then the rule of law is DEAD in America.
---
**Just last week, a bloodthirsty left-wing judge threatened me with contempt and imprisonment if I didn’t recite her dictated false version of covered-up massive evidence of voter fraud.**
---
I had a choice to make: _I could recite the state-sanctioned propaganda like an obedient little dog and be rewarded with a pat on the head. Or, I could have the courage to stand for what I know to be true._
---
When I remind you of this Bible verse, you’ll know exactly which choice I made: "_For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?_ " (Mark 8:36)
---
You see, I refuse to give up on America. That’s why I’m going on trial to fight to save my home, my liberty, and __our__ Republic.
---
_Are YOU with me?_ Will you join the cause to “SAVE RUDY?”
---
