clean_body: The trial of my life begins this week. And I don’t get a jury! | Fellow Patriot, With the trial of my life set to begin, President Donald J. Trump just said two powerful words for the entire nation to hear... “SAVE RUDY!” On Thursday, I will be on trial – without a jury, mind you – to determine whether or not I still have a home to live in. It’s a trial to save my home and a trial to fight for my basic freedoms and rights. But more than that, our nation’s very system of justice will also be on trial. If the Radical Left Democrats can get away with destroying me in a weaponized court without a jury – and possibly imprisoning me – solely because I served as President Trump’s lawyer, then the rule of law is DEAD in America. Just last week, a bloodthirsty left-wing judge threatened me with contempt and imprisonment if I didn’t recite her dictated false version of covered-up massive evidence of voter fraud. I had a choice to make: I could recite the state-sanctioned propaganda like an obedient little dog and be rewarded with a pat on the head. Or, I could have the courage to stand for what I know to be true. When I remind you of this Bible verse, you’ll know exactly which choice I made: "For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? " (Mark 8:36) You see, I refuse to give up on America. That’s why I’m going on trial to fight to save my home, my liberty, and our Republic. Are YOU with me? Will you join the cause to “SAVE RUDY?” – as I prepare for the trial that will determine whether I still even have a home to live in. And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **[hear.com](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=1d078f34750d4c08961307c0a639aea2&_e=gN_QCH6yawBF0LzjJah7UjUkph1-Maowy7DEsiQDe51u8HPP-klK0IGPj6LycXJGIfxqePG6DbjqaEBmrt_ssyflQKfknDBng4otxqRB_jBBmyqUmOrhALX5Fz86L9LdxeKcF7-KESINh1y3ScjkP_A8sqPejUicWqmZk4Or7DIenX3DEiOMb1tYqqaPiyxcp1LYaIT0RMooZ9-CJzFbnEoVxICUv5i_DBO9_o3oDGUo8JJtR_MqzJ4WV6qi9R4zIl0gHamtOZDDu-N_nvNDHKA1_4Wcypho0D3avwtrwhKNhRbUD2Mxy1D4pP8NpXB0dAlFCw3dDq2eO3y6kioi-F8ZuwLt4xQj7Vc6EoScLCPO8Z4vLi-QN5dyUHcgTmCmxr9TzOsd_93PAkyflBvMoVhPHx1NAZsv226j3XfQ3TxA3ExUENWxpgbwrPmxTLjTUVSycGOxDw3L76JrkPjz1w%3D%3D)'s IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.

| **Empowering Families with Autism Through Education**
We’re excited to invite you to the [Autism Health Summit](https://autismhealth.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7c0b21e245e40197b3670bea2&id=27a059bb4c&e=3a42edfdc4), hosted by Autism Health Inc., a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to improving the lives of individuals and families impacted by autism. This transformative event will take place at the beautiful Town and Country Resort in sunny San Diego, CA on April 11-13, 2025. Join us for an incredible weekend filled with knowledge, inspiration, and community. The Autism Health Summit will feature a lineup of [renowned speakers](https://autismhealth.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7c0b21e245e40197b3670bea2&id=d2045dba7d&e=3a42edfdc4) who are leaders in autism health and wellness, including Dr. Peter McCullough, Del Bigtree, Dr. Sabine Hazan, Dr. Brian Hooker, Dr. James Neuenswander, and many more! Whether you're a parent, practitioner, or advocate, this event offers something for everyone. We believe that access to valuable resources and education should be available to all. That’s why [scholarships are available](https://autismhealth.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7c0b21e245e40197b3670bea2&id=f20afc7e8e&e=3a42edfdc4) for low-income families who wish to attend. If you or someone you know qualifies, please reach out to us for more information on how to apply. We are proud to offer Continuing Medical Education (CME) credits for professionals attending the Autism Health Summit. This opportunity allows healthcare providers, therapists, and other practitioners to expand their knowledge of cutting-edge autism health and wellness strategies while earning credits to maintain their professional licenses. Our carefully curated sessions, led by renowned experts, are designed to deliver the latest research, innovative treatment approaches, and actionable insights that can be applied in practice. Take advantage of our special offer: Save $25 on your ticket with promo code AHS25 at checkout. Don’t wait—this exclusive discount won’t last long, and ticket prices will go up soon. Peter — Last month, Becca introduced the _**Combating Loneliness Act (CLA)**_ , sweeping legislation to tackle the loneliness epidemic by supporting community-level work to increase social connection and uplift folks who are struggling. The growing mental health emergency affects so many of us. Including Becca. And the research is clear: **Social support is vital for our emotional and physical health, and when we don’t have it, it damages our communities, civic engagement, and our democracy.** That’s why Becca is proud to have introduced this legislation to address this problem at its root. The CLA would expand social services like playgrounds, bike lanes, and community gardens to promote social connection. And invest in public health initiatives like youth mental health programs and support for health care workers. These kinds of initiatives can spark real change within our communities. **But we also know the CLA is most effective when it’s implemented alongside legislation like Medicare For All and the Green New Deal. To effectively promote healthier, stronger communities in our schools, hospitals, and across the nation, we need a holistic approach.** [**This needs our attention, Peter. subject: We must always be willing to speak out
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOCELYN BENSON FOR SECRETARY OF STATE
body:
# [](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/5?t=1&akid=33%2E181023%2EgAbfEB)
Team,
Nothing underscores the need to speak out more than the impact of staying silent. Because when we stay silent, when we choose to not raise our voices and stand up for ourselves, our families, and our greater community, what happens?
**Nothing.**
Nothing changes. No connections are made. No plans advance. No one learns anything new, no one is inspired to act, and no movements occur.
I will always choose to speak up and speak out. My north star, with roots in my faith and grounded in family, is ensuring we live in an inclusive, fair society where we honor every voice, protect every vote, keep each other safe, and recognize our common humanity.
We must always be willing to speak out, speak up, and ensure all voices are heard. It’s the only way we can enact change, and it’s the only way we can make our lives better. I hope we all have the courage to speak up when the time is right.
In solidarity,
Jocelyn

Before you go... we need your help. Since her 2018 election, Secretary Benson has fought for free and fair elections. Most Christians don’t realize this...| | | [](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=37aebfcaf3bc4a8aa489734fabbba50b&_e=H6TGhcwRt1ZelGq8qPi5V7T9I1pg_eH8gUOmV0FeoW8yA-XMTQHBL_jAxWnprRIar3tv1yUbqEjarPONfST5kvcK8-3dDtuLCPv7Um3s1EeXhXnoSowizzr41D1J-o2JFCjO7b0v1xEn6Wu8XdvNi6rvLrTjMvJfCQh7sKRyuccObbX5AGmuWUBM1sRnGhtYhbYPqirHljeJJc6gcpnaiZs0U3M7cp6ceCH5K4y9rqSkWtk4BFPmDDPxf3bRzqYp0dbryGkNawdRFq3WQFiCII0n0M1y7Aq-Sgg4pnZeyylDhfXAFMQjVkUfhrdyQz20)

Peter, This is one of the most serious, and most disturbing, threats to Christians in public life . . . yet most Christians in America don't know anything about it! **The last, and strongest, line of legal defense for Christians in the United States may soon be destroyed by ideological activists, with a regulatory change being considered in ALL 50 states.** That could make critical legal victories for Americans of faith--like protection of **personal prayer** without getting fired, protection of **moral conscience** so you can't be forced to dispense abortion-inducing drugs, and even protection of students forming a **Christian student club** --IMPOSSIBLE to pursue . . . . . . and leave Christians and Americans of faith, alongside religious ministries, nonprofits, and schools, without ANY legal defense when they wrongly and unconstitutionally face threats or punishment for their biblical values! **Peter, Christian Legal Society, a fellowship, ministry, and legal defense organization since 1961, is leading the fight to protect Christian attorneys and all Americans of faith, state by state.** _**[_**Against a well-organized, well-funded opposition, we're counting on the support of generous Americans of faith like you to stand with us. Would you consider a gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, or even $500 to help support Christian Legal Society in this critical work?**_](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=37aebfcaf3bc4a8aa489734fabbba50b&_e=H6TGhcwRt1ZelGq8qPi5V7T9I1pg_eH8gUOmV0FeoW8yA-XMTQHBL_jAxWnprRIar3tv1yUbqEjarPONfST5kvcK8-3dDtuLCPv7Um3s1EeXhXnoSowizzr41D1J-o2JFCjO7b0v1xEn6Wu8XdvNi6rvLrTjMvJfCQh7sKRyuccVIkT9vA_lQs2xUYo7GXG8_x_1F_PFKuIkre1bGUitcMiuP8KqnKKKig68YjPIXe-UqfowPKEfIFRwkIawAhf9uA8-xS-9OcF9FM7EI3ljthm3gh4akphTBVoWubz6UPVw9P2alk2s7jtHrqI1QNtP)**_

---
For those who don't work in law offices, the rule change I'm discussing may sound boring or unremarkable: it's known as Model Rule 8.4(g) from the American Bar Association. **But its impact has devastating real-world consequences for Christian attorneys and all Americans of faith, as the silencing and punishment of Christian attorneys --and the faithful Americans they would otherwise defend--seems to be the sole goal of this rule change.** Without any examples of why it's needed . . . without any response to the 400+ comments and letters of concern submitted by all attorneys concerned with free speech, the American Bar Association offered no response to rightful concerns that radical activists could use this to:
* **discourage or punish attorneys** from sharing political, social, or religious viewpoints that are outside the current political orthodoxy (today, that's typically defined as "progressive" or "Woke");

* **stop attorneys from volunteering at their churches,** sitting on church boards, or serving schools they've gone to, if those schools are Christian or otherwise religious;

* **prevent attorneys from serving in Christian ministries** , no matter how much good work those ministries do in their communities; and

* **put an end to Christian attorneys doing pro bono work** **to defend religious freedom** on behalf of Christian ministries, nonprofits, or schools that proudly proclaim their commitment to biblical values!

**Peter, there is still time to stop this rule from taking root in America . . . but it requires a 50-state strategy and a major investment of time, talent, and legal work.** Christian Legal Society has led the charge on this important issue since it was first raised in 2015. But to make sure we WIN this fight--and preserve religious freedom and protection for Christian attorneys and, by extension, all Americans of faith--I'm counting on your support. _**[_**Can I count on your generous gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, or even $500 to help Christian Legal Society save these critical protections for Christian attorneys . . . and every ministry, nonprofit, or believer that those same attorneys would defend?**_](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=37aebfcaf3bc4a8aa489734fabbba50b&_e=H6TGhcwRt1ZelGq8qPi5V7T9I1pg_eH8gUOmV0FeoW8yA-XMTQHBL_jAxWnprRIar3tv1yUbqEjarPONfST5kvcK8-3dDtuLCPv7Um3s1EeXhXnoSowizzr41D1J-o2JFCjO7b0v1xEn6Wu8XdvNi6rvLrTjMvJfCQh7sKRyuccq-DEK8p8q9BKZ17PtqRuIVVlphgvWd4rKmNEAOMqIrj0Jipp4f0yIrnCkwIrgttyUuPWPH2jDW-kN6RWeLUFlu3jMh-732asqzKR6hB7KGVmd3smR_8OVPsme5YogJsur41qAgd5-efQQ8FWMzLDW)**_

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Justice Democrats has officially launched our 2026 Candidate Recruitment
campaign, and if we’re going to clean house in the Democratic Party, we
need YOUR help to find and support the next slate of working-class
candidates to run for Congress!

While the establishment looks for those who can afford to run, we look for
local leaders nominated to run by their own communities.

As we identify congressional districts with out-of-touch, corporate
Democrats to mount primary challenges against, we’re looking for people
who:

* Share the struggles of their community — what it’s like living
paycheck to paycheck, being unhoused, or navigating our broken
healthcare system;

* Are trusted and highly networked because of their work serving others,
whose voices and opinions impact a larger group of people;

* Reject Corporate PAC money and champion solutions in Congress that
match the scale, scope, and urgency of our crises.

Before they ran for Congress, AOC was a bartender, Cori Bush was a nurse,
Jamaal Bowman was a school principal, and Summer Lee was a community
organizer and State Representative — working-class people with the lived
experience to fight for our shared values and interests in the halls of
power.

We are looking for nurses, teachers, union leaders, workers of all kinds,
and other everyday people who have demonstrated their leadership through
service and sacrifice for others.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250114-2?refcode=em20250114-36319&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36319_1203867_3YAGoO&akid=36319%2E1203867%2E3YAGoO ]Right now, we need to raise $100k by February 1 to bring on an
additional staffer and build the necessary resources to launch as many
candidates as possible. Are you able to chip in?

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250114-2?refcode=em20250114-36319&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36319_1203867_3YAGoO&akid=36319%2E1203867%2E3YAGoO ]Contribute $5

Even if these leaders may not become candidates themselves, they can help
Justice Democrats work with the folks on the ground in your district to
find the best candidate to represent your community.

Thank you for any support you can provide to help us find the next Justice
Democrats candidates to run in 2026.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

PS — If you know anyone who fits the bill to be the next Justice Democrats
candidate for Congress, [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/38356?source=em20250114-36319&t=1002&akid=36319%2E1203867%2E3YAGoO ]nominate them here!

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20250114-36319-footer&t=1003&refcode2=36319_1203867_3YAGoO&akid=36319%2E1203867%2E3YAGoO

name: Kristen McDonald Rivet
subject: Any tips?
body:
|
#
Hello, I’ve officially notched just over one week on the job in Congress, and it’s already been full of surprises. I’d love to tell you some of mine, and also to learn about yours... Here it goes for me: For starters, I didn’t expect D.C. to “shut down” temporarily due to some snow. A few of my colleagues weren't exactly happy to commute in 8 inches of snow, but a little sprinkling won’t stop this Michigander. It also seems that we might be voting on a bill to rename the Gulf of Mexico. 🙄 Surprises aside, it was humbling to vote in my very first joint session to certify the 2024 presidential race. Win or lose, respecting election results is vital, and certifying the election was a duty I took very seriously. Even more, I am thrilled that the first vote I cast as a member of Congress was for a Speaker Hakeem Jeffries – which I hope we make a reality in 2 years – and I was so excited to co-sponsor my first piece of legislation. I know politics feels broken to almost everybody right now, but it doesn’t have to stay that way. I know we can make progress without the distractions and ugliness. We can debate substance without division and polarization. **Those are some of my twists and turns from 2025 so far, but I would love to hear from you -- can you reply to this email with something you found surprising or interesting so far this year?** I can’t wait to read (and reply to) your responses! Kristen P.S. While you’re at it, please send over some of your best snow survival tips for my new colleagues in Washington. It's only Tuesday and already this week sucks.
Starbucks announced the end to its open doors policy, which defined the brand since its founding, to allegedly prevent homeless people from using the restrooms. Apparently they're under the misconception that people who don't own houses also don't drink coffee. Pretty soon people will be asked for "proof of housing" before they're served in restaurants.
Republicans voted to exclude about a dozen American women from women's sports, because it's not like California is on fire or anything important is going on.
Capital One stole $2 billion in interest owed to customers using their 360 Savings account (which includes me).
The United States still refuses to address the H5N1 epidemic, and 18 million egg-laying birds died last week as a result. As such, the price of eggs has again spiked and producers say it'll take 6-9 months to recover.
The Jack Smith report is being buried under Pete Hegseth's confirmation hearings.

Biden stated that his biggest mistake as President was not doing more to combat misinformation - despite the repeated instances of Biden being caught repeating lies about Gaza and Palestine.

There is no justice in the system.

# FROM THE DESK OF LARRY KUDLOW
---
| | Reader,**I am pleased to share with you that The New York Sun, one of my daily must-read papers, is now the exclusive publisher of my regular columns.

I invite you to consider joining the Sun to receive unlimited access to my latest commentary, alongside some of the finest American journalism.

**But there's also far more to what the Sun is building.

As you know, journalism isn't what it used to be.

I've been in the business for decades, and never before have I seen this once noble profession so abused. The major papers are no longer on the side of the American people, and we are right to withhold our trust.

The impact on our democracy is considerable. Without real accountability, the worst actors in government and at corporate institutions have free reign, and patriotic, hard-working Americans are being sidelined and ignored.

The antidote is to join the movement to build a better alternative. That's the American way.

**The charge to restore American journalism is being led by the Sun.** A proudly all-American, principled publication that has plenty of room for conservative thought and conservative writers, the Sun has upheld the highest journalistic standards since 1833. That's 18 years before the New York Times published its first number.**My decision for the New York Sun to become the exclusive publisher of my regular columns was not taken lightly.**

I value their work and have been impressed by their team, but I know they have a hell of a battle ahead. They are the David facing many Goliaths.

They will only succeed if we join with them in this grassroots national effort. Joining the Sun costs as little as a penny a day. I encourage you to sign up today. Every single person counts.

Pete Hegseth **[DESTROYED ultra-woke Sen. Elizabeth Warren](https://substack.com/redirect/0e9bf5c5-312d-4a81-92a2-3581f8fe34fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after she tried to bully him using his past comments during today's intense confirmation hearings.

Hegseth refrained from answering directly, **[which really pissed Warren off.](https://substack.com/redirect/0e9bf5c5-312d-4a81-92a2-3581f8fe34fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
"You are quite sure that every General who serves should not go directly into the defense industry for 10 years but you're not willing to make that same pledge?"
"I'm not a General, Senator," Hegseth said bluntly, causing the entire chamber to erupt into laughter.

Illinois House Republican Minority Leader Tony McCombie, left, and former Republican nominee for Illinois Attorney General, Thomas G. DeVore.
By Illinois Review

On Monday morning, former Republican nominee for Illinois Attorney General Thomas DeVore filed a lawsuit against Illinois House Republican Minority Leader Tony McCombie in federal court in Chicago, for violating his First Amendment rights after he made “critical comments” of the GOP leader’s vote to support expanding transgender patient rights.

The suit, which is with the District Court for the Northern District of Illinois,
states (https://www.politico.com/f/?id=00000194-6314-d7e4-af9d-e3145b610000&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=12d984fb20-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) , “In an effort to suppress dissent in this forum, McCombie hides or deletes certain comments that criticize her or her policies, thereby making those comments invisible to the other constituents who are engaging in discussion on her Facebook Page and preventing certain citizens from engaging in debate with other members of the community.”

The federal lawsuit continues, “In at least one instance, Minority Leader McCombie has permanently banned Plaintiff [DeVore] from being able to engage in this forum at all after he has posted comments critical of the McCombie’s political activities, thereby completely prohibiting Plaintiff from being able to petition the Republican House Minority Leader on this public forum.”
https://www.politico.com/f/?id=00000194-6314-d7e4-af9d-e3145b610000&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=12d984fb20-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
In an exclusive with Politico (https://www.politico.com/newsletters/illinois-playbook/2025/01/14/illinois-gop-leader-sued-over-social-media-actions-00198034?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=12d984fb20-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) , DeVore said, “I’ve criticized her decisions as an elected official: Things that she’s doing, things that she’s voting on, people she takes money from. They’re perfectly politically appropriate issues to be debating, and she doesn’t want people to see, so she blocks me from being able to access her platform.”

In a conversation on Tuesday with Illinois Review, DeVore insisted that this suit was not about money, but principle and protecting First Amendment rights. He also suggested donating any monetary reward to support the grassroots.

McCombie is under fire from Republicans and even her own constituents for joining with Democrats and supporting a bill in 2023 that expanded patient rights for transgender and non-binary individuals.

But the controversy continues – leading up too, and after voting in favor of the bill, McCombie received an influx of campaign donations from a progressive hospital association that’s been advocating for improved care for transgender and non-binary patients. DeVore, who has amassed a large social media following, was commenting on his own Facebook page about McCombie’s vote when he discovered that he no longer could link her public figure page because he had been blocked.

They’re perfectly politically appropriate issues to be debating, and she doesn’t want people to see, so she blocks me from being able to access her platform.” In a conversation on Tuesday with Illinois Review, DeVore insisted that this suit was not about money, but principle and protecting First Amendment rights. He also suggested donating any monetary reward to support the grassroots. McCombie is under fire from Republicans and even her own constituents for joining with Democrats and supporting a bill in 2023 that expanded patient rights for transgender and non-binary individuals. | | | | | [ ](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fourtenn.org%2F/1/010f019466c49098-b5d03782-ea32-46e4-a8fc-c169de1f0850-000000/7tQXDFMXpoYiLSRyiXyk4nlPMHg=193)

Hello Peter,
---
| | Today the new session of the Tennessee General Assembly began.

It’s a new year but it’s the same Tennessee Republicans pushing the same regressive agenda. Time and again we see the impact these policies have on everyday Tennesseans. And in 2025 we’re not going to stand by while they ram through voucher programs, restrict women’s access to IVF, withhold state funds from cities, and support ending the US Department of Education.

There’s no doubt it’s a scary time in our country. And it looks like the incoming administration plans to take a page out of Bill Lee and Cameron Sexton’s own handbook and bring the divisive politics they’ve tested out in Tennessee to the national stage.

It’s easy to get discouraged and just want to give up. But we can’t look away now.

We here at Our Tennessee Future PAC will be here to guide you through this legislative session so we can fight back together, with truth and compassion on our side.

**Keep an eye on your inbox for regular updates from us to stay informed this session.** We’ll be bringing you the facts, shining a light on exactly what the Republican leadership is doing and holding them accountable.

You can also follow us on [Twitter](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fx.com%2FOurTennPac/1/010f019466c49098-b5d03782-ea32-46e4-a8fc-c169de1f0850-000000/Pp10SXbVeSaYzQ3prwlYmvFW_6A=193), [Facebook](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2FOurTennesseeFuture/1/010f019466c49098-b5d03782-ea32-46e4-a8fc-c169de1f0850-000000/-nJCarC9CuFBFeihSU9fjA3Lw2o=193), and [Instagram](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fourtennpac%2F/1/010f019466c49098-b5d03782-ea32-46e4-a8fc-c169de1f0850-000000/TBQsCQ5fxFvypqiEp4G4H9puc68=193) to stay up to date on the latest from the legislature.

We as Tennessee Democrats must come together. With the spotlight on the White House, no one else is going to pay attention.

In the districts where we had the resources to spend in the 2024 elections we saw the impact they had and were able to defend competitive seats. We can change the balance of power in our state in 2026. But we can’t wait until two months before the next election to try.

That work has to start now. And that work has to start with us.

**FOLLOW US ON SOCIAL MEDIA**

name: Patti Reilly
subject: Help me save my son
body:
Never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be wrongfully convicted of murder – murder of a criminal my son didn’t even touch.
Dear Fellow American,

My son, Washington Metro Police Officer Terence Sutton, was just sentenced to 5 1⁄2 years in prison for doing the job he was trained to do.

And though you and I have never met, I’m praying you’ll help me save him.

Here are some photos of Terence as a little boy.

[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=14cd63c31e854457b720a1331f53c1d3&_e=wutoS35Y-FlL-QT5A3YdVPDQi61-3hV7-fvOs25u5KoCqAghvXK4Y8-RTggiPF_-rE97c_Cugrm3_iUyU3NdRqb8BrwRl0K_aUDQCpQna430Lk6UfWKQpTczWXp1Y7o6ZFqm10PatS1DIWk-JYCXu0-MsVpy0Qlm2Qt7PHlZPAntlZ54e5YXrMQAiGl3FWf6hyFS4YwSkEegnCG4asNWt_VeJjmloUvA8MGWYIQI3voAGCJvBKE1iNTTq8-BAOqO8h6Dv69nzhk24y2WMEhENfK6LgEZ0XU5dQKTCTEANouhbOjs635l8Wlz60Pjk55tUpi452hOnfwup8xsIESqQio_Ejt-MDwW-VmypNIVxDHqhwyI_ITguD1p_sgPOcDEnqA-AutMqmcTCfMSqlDfQw%3D%3D)
He always dreamed of following in his dad’s footsteps to be a police officer. I also included one of my favorites of us from the night he graduated from the Police Academy.

I was so proud that night.

Never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be _wrongfully_ _convicted_ _of_ _murder_ **– murder of a criminal my son didn’t even touch.**

[**_I’m praying you will help me save my son_**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=14cd63c31e854457b720a1331f53c1d3&_e=wutoS35Y-FlL-QT5A3YdVPDQi61-3hV7-fvOs25u5KoCqAghvXK4Y8-RTggiPF_-rE97c_Cugrm3_iUyU3NdRqb8BrwRl0K_aUDQCpQna430Lk6UfWKQpTczWXp1Y7o6ZFqm10PatS1DIWk-JYCXu0-MsVpy0Qlm2Qt7PHlZPAntlZ54e5YXrMQAiGl3FWf6hyFS4YwSkEegnCG4asNWt_VeJjmloUvA8MGWYIQI3vpmZXREOGzfQJevUJfZMxqvxj1Npgvl4yYyGVOl-vypdRyD90M17jLz73mo4xOXEciVfflgaeMnVLqx55IiULuzPe48ppvpRLFymr2J-AdBWzePrLmhiHejdlterKY3kvN9XFe3nvasOzSUV_oA2byTLUT1id6S3UGXI009_DwCsw%3D%3D) – **but first, let me explain what happened.** Our nightmare started in October of 2020.

Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen entering a rival gang’s territory.

Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long – including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier that day, he was seen arguing with a rival gang member who owed him money. So Terence and other officers were concerned Karon was planning to get revenge.

When Terence saw Karon illegally driving a motorized scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull him over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter.

Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs.

My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3 minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol car.

Then it happened.

Karon veered into an alleyway, drove out the other side without looking and slammed into a passing car.

After several days in the hospital, Karon died from his injuries. And here’s where the story takes a shocking turn...

Because Karon was black, and the incident happened just four months after George Floyd’s death, the anti-police mob went into frenzy.

They blamed Terence for the accident and smeared him as a racist.

There were protests and even riots. The mob threw rocks at officers, smashed store windows, and set fires.

Anti-police politicians piled on too. Without any evidence, they demanded my son be charged even though he did nothing to cause Karon’s death.

**The pressure campaign worked and prosecutors charged my son with Second-Degree Murder.**

**Terence was convicted in December 2022 and he was finally just sentenced – to 5 1⁄2 years in prison.**

Now you understand why I’m so heartbroken. The injustice is almost too much to bear.

My son was well-respected by the community he served. He trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them. He was even awarded Officer of the Year!

But unless Terence’s appeal is successful, he’s going to prison – which is why I’m urgently turning to you for help today. The **Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund** (LELDF) has stepped forward to pay for Terence’s defense and is actively raising funds to pay for the appeal.

If you’ve ever heard of LELDF, you know they’re a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Terence for over 30 years. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops – and their families – at their lowest moments.

We expect it will cost at least $150,000 to appeal Terence’s conviction.

So I have to ask you one of the toughest questions I’ve ever asked anyone:

[**_Will you help my son Terence fight the unjust charges against him by donating to LELDF today?_**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=14cd63c31e854457b720a1331f53c1d3&_e=wutoS35Y-FlL-QT5A3YdVPDQi61-3hV7-fvOs25u5KoCqAghvXK4Y8-RTggiPF_-rE97c_Cugrm3_iUyU3NdRqb8BrwRl0K_aUDQCpQna430Lk6UfWKQpTczWXp1Y7o6ZFqm10PatS1DIWk-JYCXu0-MsVpy0Qlm2Qt7PHlZPAntlZ54e5YXrMQAiGl3FWf6hyFS4YwSkEegnCG4asNWt_VeJjmloUvA8MGWYIQI3vpIG3YrsT7F5KJ6UfKpOxtOxKQZmy6lsbC6mmG1dQkVZmUgDY_ESrk257YvWXIWPKijdlip5cVs4hGgEJ918e4w-GFQpVOS241h278HuoR-uqi1ncynYtb2vb6XKuqqMcKkHIDYMPmg0ne-ursJGj6NPL1iQpRT1-UN2stBAETygQ%3D%3D)

I’m not asking you to donate the entire $150,000 yourself – though it would be a huge weight off our shoulders if you are able to help that way.

[**_But your tax-deductible gift of $35, $50, $100, or more will help LELDF fully fund Terence’s appeal over the next 12 months._**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=14cd63c31e854457b720a1331f53c1d3&_e=wutoS35Y-FlL-QT5A3YdVPDQi61-3hV7-fvOs25u5KoCqAghvXK4Y8-RTggiPF_-rE97c_Cugrm3_iUyU3NdRqb8BrwRl0K_aUDQCpQna430Lk6UfWKQpTczWXp1Y7o6ZFqm10PatS1DIWk-JYCXu0-MsVpy0Qlm2Qt7PHlZPAntlZ54e5YXrMQAiGl3FWf6hyFS4YwSkEegnCG4asNWt_VeJjmloUvA8MGWYIQI3vr4bmY7iWM6-RJpYwGsopQ7f_gXO32yn5Vfud_q0hyGAQz92yPru4Xy15yl9DYGOhUsZyuW7PGD_6bDYphvzEt0ZAZG1CF00opfPgefmOjJF10Fu6Zg7hXygkWztmC2vo6WOCdFRekAFNQvmM0Bq6QVK9VxlqrNSRfUZD8tnTLBrg%3D%3D) If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn’t be so bold as to ask for your help.

But I already lost my husband. He was a police officer too, and he was so proud that Terence followed in his footsteps. I simply can’t bear the thought of having another family member ripped away from me.

[**_So if you are at all able, please follow this link to make a tax-deductible donation to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund to help my Terence._**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=14cd63c31e854457b720a1331f53c1d3&_e=wutoS35Y-FlL-QT5A3YdVPDQi61-3hV7-fvOs25u5KoCqAghvXK4Y8-RTggiPF_-rE97c_Cugrm3_iUyU3NdRqb8BrwRl0K_aUDQCpQna430Lk6UfWKQpTczWXp1Y7o6ZFqm10PatS1DIWk-JYCXu0-MsVpy0Qlm2Qt7PHlZPAntlZ54e5YXrMQAiGl3FWf6hyFS4YwSkEegnCG4asNWt_VeJjmloUvA8MGWYIQI3voyrUzm3BCNWzv3vlexmyw1PerX4Jk3LUc1I99DBsHBiR-KKX35rYuTAGKutz4wr495xe2ba2ni8ZmolFW028mPITbavcaYm9B6G1n80_948Ek8SBaS4woxd--zW98BbJkBvc3VDfyuzw2s8siPzBLRezmptz4NvUCoEXeon61Rtg%3D%3D)

**Any amount – $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or more – will help.**

And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. But whatever you can afford to give, I ask that you rush it back quickly.

Right now, Terence can only rely on the good nature and generosity of kind folks like you.

Thank you for taking the time to read my letter today.

And thank you in advance for helping LELDF support Terence and other wrongly accused officers.

Gratefully,
**Patti Reilly**

body:
I’m safe, but so many others need our help. Here’s what you can do.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100400152/522639708/1328794144?refcode=ea.4ae406a5-c4d2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ms=ea.4ae406a5-c4d2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRhZTQwNmE1LWM0ZDItZWYxMS04OGQwLTAwMjI0ODJhOWQ5MiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=M5wqFkvmj-b-KYM0tr7Q4hdyGWolcATw1h_S8foFAqU=&emci=77c42473-8cd2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=4ae406a5-c4d2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=4823105)
---
Hey — it’s Jane. First, I want to let you know my family and I are safe. Like so many of you, I’ve been watching with a breaking heart as devastating fires tear through Los Angeles and surrounding areas. The scale of loss is staggering. Yesterday on TV, I watched an aerial view of the Palisades fire. Block after block after block, it's an unending landscape of flat gray rubble. This city is my home. This is where I grew up. I used to seek solace as a child in the very hills that have been scorched by flames. It's excruciating to see my city and the people I love go through this. I am so deeply sorry to all those who have been affected by the fires. From Altadena to the Palisades, my heart is with all of you. I also want to express my deepest gratitude to the firefighters and first responders working tirelessly to protect lives and communities. These brave individuals are facing unthinkable challenges — battling fast-moving flames fueled by extremely dry conditions and hurricane-force winds. Their courage and sacrifice remind us of the best of humanity in the worst of circumstances. If these fires have impacted you or someone you know, please don’t hesitate to seek help. **Below are some resources that can provide immediate support:** |
* **[Red Cross Los Angeles:](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100400157/522639712/948221356?refcode=ea.4ae406a5-c4d2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ms=ea.4ae406a5-c4d2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRhZTQwNmE1LWM0ZDItZWYxMS04OGQwLTAwMjI0ODJhOWQ5MiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=M5wqFkvmj-b-KYM0tr7Q4hdyGWolcATw1h_S8foFAqU=&emci=77c42473-8cd2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=4ae406a5-c4d2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=4823105)** Provides shelter, food, and emotional support to those affected by disasters.

* **[Los Angeles County Fire Department:](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100400161/522639717/237875965?refcode=ea.4ae406a5-c4d2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ms=ea.4ae406a5-c4d2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRhZTQwNmE1LWM0ZDItZWYxMS04OGQwLTAwMjI0ODJhOWQ5MiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=M5wqFkvmj-b-KYM0tr7Q4hdyGWolcATw1h_S8foFAqU=&emci=77c42473-8cd2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=4ae406a5-c4d2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=4823105)** Offers up-to-date information on evacuation centers and safety guidelines.

* **[California Community Foundation Wildfire Relief Fund:](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100400165/522639721/586874683?refcode=ea.4ae406a5-c4d2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ms=ea.4ae406a5-c4d2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRhZTQwNmE1LWM0ZDItZWYxMS04OGQwLTAwMjI0ODJhOWQ5MiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=M5wqFkvmj-b-KYM0tr7Q4hdyGWolcATw1h_S8foFAqU=&emci=77c42473-8cd2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=4ae406a5-c4d2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=4823105)** Offers financial support to individuals and organizations for recovery efforts.

* **[Los Angeles Regional Food Bank:](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100400169/522639725/1612329035?refcode=ea.4ae406a5-c4d2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ms=ea.4ae406a5-c4d2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRhZTQwNmE1LWM0ZDItZWYxMS04OGQwLTAwMjI0ODJhOWQ5MiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=M5wqFkvmj-b-KYM0tr7Q4hdyGWolcATw1h_S8foFAqU=&emci=77c42473-8cd2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=4ae406a5-c4d2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=4823105)** Distributes food and essential supplies to residents in need.

* **[United Way of Greater Los Angeles:](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100400173/522639729/1332321251?refcode=ea.4ae406a5-c4d2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ms=ea.4ae406a5-c4d2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRhZTQwNmE1LWM0ZDItZWYxMS04OGQwLTAwMjI0ODJhOWQ5MiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=M5wqFkvmj-b-KYM0tr7Q4hdyGWolcATw1h_S8foFAqU=&emci=77c42473-8cd2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=4ae406a5-c4d2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=4823105)** Focuses on longer-term recovery efforts to support community members.

* **[Pasadena Humane Society:](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100400176/522639733/1828597140?refcode=ea.4ae406a5-c4d2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ms=ea.4ae406a5-c4d2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRhZTQwNmE1LWM0ZDItZWYxMS04OGQwLTAwMjI0ODJhOWQ5MiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=M5wqFkvmj-b-KYM0tr7Q4hdyGWolcATw1h_S8foFAqU=&emci=77c42473-8cd2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=4ae406a5-c4d2-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=4823105)** Serves animal needs in disaster-affected areas and conducts search and rescue for pets left behind or animals in need of urgent medical care.

---
While the fires rage on, there are some who are using this tragedy to score political points. They're spreading misinformation about firefighting efforts and pointing fingers at local leaders. It's unconscionable.
Firefighters faced an impossible battle — dry conditions, gusts of up to 100 mph, and a climate crisis that is making extreme weather more dangerous by the year. We need to confront the root cause of this crisis — an ever-warming climate — and invest in solutions to protect our communities _before_ disasters strike.
If you’re able, please consider supporting one of the organizations listed above or finding other ways to assist Southern California residents. Every act of kindness and shared resource can make a difference.
Thank you for caring and for showing up when it matters most.
With gratitude,
\- Jane Fonda

| **A Web of Small Donors, Big Questions: An Investigation into Campaign Finance**
_By Dominic Rapini, American Businessman and Political Commentator_
In 2018, while running for the U.S. Senate, I studied my opponent, Chris Murphy, ’s FEC filings. My goal was simple: to understand how he raised such vast sums nationwide. The numbers were staggering, almost unbelievable. As I sifted through the data, patterns emerged that were hard to ignore.
I noticed donors donating four or five times a day, often in small amounts like $1 or $5, with some donating as many as 30 times per month. The source of money was questionable, but a common denominator began to stand out: the donors were often 78 years old or older, and it became clear that many were unsuspecting. These donations were being made in their names but **were NOT from their bank accounts** and without their knowledge or consent, as determined from **first-hand interviews**. In May 2023, I compiled and provided this data to Attorney General William Tong, determined to shine a light on what I believed to be a disturbing case of elder abuse, identity theft, and potentially illegal campaign financing. He has **not responded** since providing his office with these findings and extensive data. That was May, 2023.
As someone who has worked in Silicon Valley for over three decades, I’ve learned how to analyze data, identify patterns, and detect trends. That experience equipped me to create a working theory of what I was looking at: a highly coordinated, automated system funneling small-dollar donations through unwitting individuals. The sheer frequency and scale pointed to something far beyond typical grassroots fundraising—it looked like a deliberate scheme operating in the shadows of our campaign finance system. From whom? Foreign actors, corporations? We don’t know, yet.
In the Spring of 2023, my associate Chris Coyle (Pomfret Chair) and I presented this data and our findings to RNC officials and congressional staffers in Washington, D.C. Despite the evidence and the alarming implications, the response was disappointing. Few seemed willing to investigate what I saw as a potential threat to the integrity of elections and the financial security of countless Americans.
As questions arise about unprecedented fundraising hauls—**like Kamala Harris raising $81 million in a single day through small donations** —I can’t help but revisit what I uncovered. Could these patterns offer a clue? For anyone interested, the tools to investigate are accessible. FEC reports can be downloaded at FEC.gov, and with some effort in Excel, patterns may emerge, just as they did for me.
It’s not just about connecting dots—it’s about safeguarding the integrity of our republic. Our press has largely abandoned the intellectual curiosity required to unravel such complex issues, so we, as citizens, must step in and demand answers. What I uncovered isn’t just a campaign finance anomaly—it’s a warning sign for the health of our democracy.
**Read the article regarding my findings from the Daily Signal Below:**

# Where Does the Money Come From? Elderly Democrats Say Donations Made in Their Names Aren’t Genuine
[Elizabeth Troutman Mitchell ](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=b5757a207d&e=8763c56857) | January 08, 2025
****[**Article LINK**](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=8bb2c1cf10&e=8763c56857) Democratic fundraising platform [ActBlue](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=38da73ae88&e=8763c56857) may have raked in millions through fraudulent donations, according to the testimonies of elderly Americans who said federal election records do not reflect their giving.
Eighteen [registered Democrats](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=46240ccc85&e=8763c56857) in Connecticut, all over the age of 70, appear to have donated $1.9 million to Democratic causes, including ActBlue, through hundreds of thousands of small donations from 2016 to 2024, according to a review of Federal Election Commission filings by Dominic Rapini, cybersecurity company CEO and a former Connecticut Republican candidate for office.
Curious about the donation patterns, Rapini tracked down some of the Connecticut residents and asked them if they really did make thousands of small donations, sometimes multiple in a day, [through ActBlue](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=2c848c5b2b&e=8763c56857).
The Daily Signal depends on the support of readers like you. [Donate now](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=7ebda69aac&e=8763c56857)Several of the supposed donors told Rapini they did not make any of the reported donations, nor did they know anything about how their names were being used, Rapini told [The Daily Signal](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=be0a6df8ac&e=8763c56857).
An 88-year-old retired Yale University professor, for example, supposedly made 7,539 donations for a total of $213,163, according to FEC records. After Rapini informed him about the significant donations in his name, he signed an affidavit saying, “I believe this does not reflect my donation frequency or dollars I have donated.” According to Rapini, who has analyzed numbers for three decades in the tech industry, this is a possible case of alleged identity theft and money laundering. A contribution made by one person in the name of another is illegal.“When I examine the donation patterns tied to these alleged ‘smurfs,’ the irregularities jump off the page, revealing behavior that defies both human logic and common sense,” he told The Daily Signal. “To safeguard trust in our election process, we must confront these anomalies head-on.”
[Rep. Bryan Steil](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=b63a0314e8&e=8763c56857), R-Wis., chairman of the House Administration Committee, told The Daily Signal he’s aware of similar reports from across the country. “In response, last fall, I shared the findings of our investigation with several state attorneys general,” Steil said in an emailed statement. “The committee and I remain fully available to collaborate with any state law enforcement officials who wish to access the information we have gathered on this critical issue.”An elderly acupuncturist and registered Democrat appears to have made 17 donations in 2022 through ActBlue totaling $317. In an email to Rapini, she promised she hasn’t made political contributions since 2016.
“I can promise you I have NOT made donations myself to the [Democratic National Committee] or Democratic local party since 2016 ... ,” she said. “Anything past that are fake and/or manipulated donations.”
A 91-year-old woman appears to have made 2,591 donations totaling $41,000, according to FEC filings. She signed an affidavit with Rapini denying making the reported donations.
Another 75-year-old woman looks to have made 4,270 small donations adding up to $32,323. She too signed an affidavit with Rapini denying making the donations in this frequency or quantity.
**ActBlue is currently under congressional investigation for alleged laundering of foreign money laundering.**
ActBlue came under fire on Oct. 29 because of its donor-verification policies. In a letter that day to ActBlue, Steil said foreign actors from Iran, Russia, Venezuela, and China could use the platform to launder illicit money for use in U.S. political campaigns.
The Democratic fundraising platform admitted in 2023 to Steil that it didn’t require contributors to use a card verification value, or CVV, to donate on its website with a credit card. Those security codes are meant to ensure that the person making a purchase physically possesses the credit card.
ActBlue responded to The Daily Signal’s request for comment about the affidavits by referring The Daily Signal to a post on its [blog](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=9f9035daf4&e=8763c56857), which says, “Because of how reporting works for intermediaries, contributions made on platforms like ours often show up more than once in public FEC records, because both ActBlue and the receiving campaign or committee must report the contributions.
“FEC rules require ActBlue to itemize every contribution made through its platform, regardless of amount,” the post says.“Additionally, FEC reports often lump multiple donors with the same name together,” the post continues. “This can make it difficult to easily identify which contributions should be associated with each individual donor, especially donors with common names.”
Rapini said whether the suspicious donation patterns come from “sloppy data systems at the FEC” or “nefarious actors laundering money through unsuspecting elderly donors,” an investigation is needed. **“Transparency and accountability are nonnegotiable when it comes to protecting the integrity of our democracy,” he said.**

#
Right now, professional provocateurs are attempting to derail this new session of Congress with grandstanding.
Meanwhile, Donald Trump is once again making headlines with bizarre (and downright reckless) ideas like renaming the “Gulf of Mexico” the “Gulf of America” and buying Greenland.
These antics are nothing more than distractions from the fact that Trump and his allies in Congress have no policy solutions for the challenges facing Americans.
**Sarah refuses to divert her attention from what really matters: fighting for workers, protecting retirees, and lowering costs for everyday Delawareans.**
On Friday, Sarah became the first freshman Democrat to introduce a bill in this new Congress. Less than a week from getting the keys to her office!
As she rolls up her sleeves and gets started on the hard work ahead, Sarah needs your help to keep up the fight.
Most members of Congress spend huge amounts of time on the phone with wealthy donors — not Sarah. | Dear Hello First, let's talk about what happened today. And then talk about what's coming up tomorrow.
Much happened today legislatively, including a number of controversial bills which passed out of Senate committee and will now move to the full Senate for a vote.
Unfortunately, the Democrats control both the House and the Senate, so we know they will pass.
Unfortunately, Governor Youngkin will not be able to veto these Constitutional Amendments.
Our only hope to defeat these measures is to next year win back the House and Governor's seat.
Here are the Constitutional Amendments:
[SJ247](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001vYgAPfdTJmX5K6HSSMAQHAkCWQVC9WPvmeBoN2oEunvMWVn7FyaIfVJP-BTzQ_pzI_HQJKfsz4IwkcQ9z9rNgaSFc8mig1c22nHUIcku8QdoobwbehZ4OgHdVhgMzXsOE89nBVA4GLuo0QR3xQ0IM0idaJiqnctkP6DMc7BGU07twBvr2TE5NFoSv3gRvkck&c=c__s4RDwap2EaRKYojs7gDrgB3NFk1hoZi9nfLcW9wB4Q3woymlq7g==&ch=ycJn1tTSlc8zJCmIbQYJv_Nh4wR_sr_oG_Qu6U-g919X--a_265EXA==) Boysko Constitutional amendment (first reference) fundamental right to reproductive freedom passed out of the Senate Privileges and Elections Committee on a party line vote 8 to 6.

Now let's talk about bills coming up on Wednesday. I've poured over all of the Senate bills coming up tomorrow and I have to say this.
It really irks me when Republicans introduce bills to increase taxes and the size of government, but it happens.
And Wednesday it will happen again.
I know I'm going to ruffle some feathers here or be labeled as "divisive," but Republicans shouldn't vote or sponsor bills to increase taxes nor should that pass bills that increase state bureaucracy.
Republicans aren't supposed to raise taxes. We expect that of Democrats, but not Republicans. We raise consciences not taxes.

This is a local sales and use tax to levy additional taxes for school projects.
Another Republican Senator wants to establish a Museum of the Virginia National Guard with [SB766](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001vYgAPfdTJmX5K6HSSMAQHAkCWQVC9WPvmeBoN2oEunvMWVn7FyaIfVJP-BTzQ_pzpWA0isY61d_c7j-hd4H549zyZJppk0zK-BwrkTKqRVLXs7Uh9yJhTmJjHWNM6yuzt5pZrsCg96VqtQfgRqLq3v6Iyb3JNcch8U0EKYmphAXhyWG3gVab36hsc9RyvaSG&c=c__s4RDwap2EaRKYojs7gDrgB3NFk1hoZi9nfLcW9wB4Q3woymlq7g==&ch=ycJn1tTSlc8zJCmIbQYJv_Nh4wR_sr_oG_Qu6U-g919X--a_265EXA==). While I'm all for supporting our National Guard, as Republicans we should be spending taxpayer money on the core functions of government, not museums.
Once the museum is up and running, it will be taxpayers that must continue to pay for maintenance and upkeep of the museum.

Friend, This week we’re interviewing applicants to our Rooted in Community Campaign School―a _free_ in-person program to train progressive candidates running for local and state office. **While we budgeted to train 15 candidates, we received a record number of applicants and we’d love to expand this year’s Campaign School further.** The cost per trainee is just $400, which means that every donation, whether it’s $5 or $400, goes a long way toward training future leaders to run for office. As billionaires keep spending more to influence our elections, we need to keep supporting candidates who can’t typically afford the high costs of running for office. That’s why we provide our Rooted in Community Campaign School for free. **The Rooted in Community Campaign School focuses on training women of color and BIPOC* candidates with the lived experience needed to serve our communities.** This month-long course will take place over five Saturdays in February and March. While we budgeted to train 15 candidates, we received a record number of applicants and we’d love to expand this year’s Campaign School further. The cost per trainee is just $400, which means that every donation, whether it’s $5 or $400, goes a long way toward training future leaders to run for office. As billionaires keep spending more to influence our elections, we need to keep supporting candidates who can’t typically afford the high costs of running for office. That’s why we provide our Rooted in Community Campaign School for free. The Rooted in Community Campaign School focuses on training women of color and BIPOC candidates with the lived experience needed to serve our communities. This month-long course will take place over five Saturdays in February and March. | A friend once told me, “People like us never think about running for office and that’s the problem.” That’s exactly why we created the Rooted in Community Campaign School. We’ll train candidates on the fundamentals of running a grassroots campaign from communications to field work to fundraising and more―and we’ll ensure that each of these campaign strategies is rooted in community and reflects the needs of each candidate’s district, whether they’re running for local or statewide office. name: Center for Reproductive Rights
subject: Who's threatening repro rights this week?
body:
https://secure.reproductiverights.org/a/giving-tuesday-2024

Each week, the Center for Reproductive Rights will preview the Senate confirmation hearings for Trump nominees who pose a threat to reproductive rights.

🚨Tomorrow, we're launching a new online tool with up-to-date information on these nominees, the damage they could do, and how you can fight back. Text JOIN to 73776 for access to the tool as soon as it launches!

Confirmation Hearings This Week: 1/14 - 1/19

January 14: Secretary of Veterans Affairs - Doug Collins
In This Role He Could:
* Reinstate the VA's total ban on abortion for veterans, even in cases of rape, incest, or to save the woman's life.
* Reinstate co-pays for birth control for certain dependents of veterans.
Red Flags:
* A+ rating from the anti-abortion group Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America.
* In response to U.S. Supreme Court Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg's death, he tweeted "RIP to the more than 30 million innocent babies that have been murdered during the decades that Ruth Bader Ginsburg defended pro-abortion laws."
* Voted against the Violence Against Women Act because it applied to lesbians and undocumented immigrants.

January 14: Secretary of Defense - Pete Hegseth
In This Role He Could:
* Restrict health care and medications for service members, including contraception and Plan B.
* Revoke a Biden-era policy that allows service members to take administrative leave to travel for abortion care or IVF treatments they cannot receive on base, and receive reimbursement for their travel costs.
Red Flags:
* Called Roe v. Wade a "generational genocide of America's unborn" and called the Dobbs ruling "a great opinion."
* Said women should not be in combat roles and that trans soldiers are "not deployable" because they are "reliant on chemicals."
* Was accused of sexual assault and paid a settlement barring the woman from speaking out. The military currently faces a sexual assault epidemic.

January 15: Secretary of State - Marco Rubio
In This Role He Could:
* Decrease access to abortion services worldwide by reinstating the Global Gag Rule. This rule prohibits Non-Governmental Organizations in other countries who receive U.S. funding from providing abortion services or information, even to victims of sexual assault.
* Defund the World Health Organization, leaving millions without basic health care.
Red Flags:
* Co-sponsored a national abortion ban multiple times in Congress, and has sponsored hundreds of other anti-abortion bills.
* Personally donated over $40,000 to the anti-abortion group Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America.
* Stated he believes life begins at conception, and that IVF poses a "very difficult bioethical issue."
* Asked the Supreme Court to overturn Roe v. Wade and to rescind FDA approval of the abortion pill mifepristone.

January 15-16: Attorney General - Pam Bondi
In This Role She Could:
* Ban abortion nationwide by misusing the Comstock Act.
* Prosecute doctors who provide abortion care to people in other states.
* Refuse to enforce the FACE Act, which prohibits protestors from blocking abortion clinic entrances and harassing patients and doctors.
Red Flags:
* As Florida Attorney General, she defended laws forcing abortion patients to undergo biased "counseling" and wait 24 hours before receiving care.
* She has stated, "as a pro-life, pro-family conservative, I feel compelled to take every possible step to protect this greatest gift from God."
* Falsely claimed in a FOX News interview that most women who've had an abortion felt pressured into it.

January 15: Office of Management & Budget Director - Russell Vought
In This Role He Could:
* Fund fake abortion clinics (also known as “crisis pregnancy centers”) through the President's budget and reject any agency rules that advance reproductive health care.
* Fast track regulations that restrict abortion, including ones that make it easier for law enforcement to access the medical records of abortion patients and defund Title X health clinics.
Red Flags:
* He is against abortion even in instances of rape, incest, or to save the life of the mother, and has said "Defending life is the most important issue to me."
* Wrote a chapter of Project 2025 that advocates for abolishing the White House Gender Policy Council, which is tasked with advancing gender equality.
* Suggested defunding fetal tissue research and said that the federal budget should be used to promote Western families having more babies.

Peter, What’s happening right now in North Carolina is outrageous. In case you missed it, a GOP supermajority on the state’s supreme court has blocked the certification of November’s state supreme court election — in which Democratic candidate, and currently serving Associate Justice, Allison Riggs was declared the winner. **This is essentially an effort by Republicans to steal a seat on North Carolina’s highest court —** a dangerous, anti-democratic power grab that could have long-lasting ramifications. **Here’s a quick explainer from _Mother Jones_ about the stakes — [and why it’s imperative that we keep working in North Carolina and across the country to push back against these partisan efforts to undermine the will of the voters:](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100401584/522644216/1531424108?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_NCMotherJones_email_20250114-NDRC-Tier1-NCMotherJonesNOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250114-NDRC-Tier1-NCMotherJonesNOR_&utm_campaign=NCMotherJones&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFlZWRjYjQ2LWNiZDItZWYxMS04OGQwLTAwMjI0ODJhOWQ5MiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ai5SfItg-morE4wpQXxMBBQ4KI75rpo4QYwQAi-_ET4=)** “The race has national significance because Riggs’ victory would give Democrats a shot at retaking the court’s majority after 2028. **That would allow them to oversee the state’s redistricting process in 2031.** That is particularly consequential because the current majority on the court upheld heavily gerrymandered maps drawn by the Republican-controlled state legislature that allowed Republicans to pick up three US House seats in November**— just enough to maintain control of the chamber and ensure one-party rule in DC.”** — Mother Jones, January 7, 2025 When control of Congress relies on such a slim margin, it’s easy to connect the dots between anti-democratic efforts in state-level elections and the impacts they can make on leadership at the national level. The domino effects of power grabs like this effort in North Carolina can be massive — and we must do everything possible to stop them to ensure fair representation across the country. That is particularly consequential because the current majority on the court upheld heavily gerrymandered maps drawn by the Republican-controlled state legislature that allowed Republicans to pick up three US House seats in November— just enough to maintain control of the chamber and ensure one-party rule in DC.” — Mother Jones, January 7, 2025 When control of Congress relies on such a slim margin, it’s easy to connect the dots between anti-democratic efforts in state-level elections and the impacts they can make on leadership at the national level. The domino effects of power grabs like this effort in North Carolina can be massive — and we must do everything possible to stop them to ensure fair representation across the country. All of us at the NDRC are committed to fighting back against widespread efforts to further partisan gerrymandering in North Carolina and other states like Ohio, Florida, and New Hampshire. But it’s going to take time and resources to keep it up — and we’re relying on the support of people like you to power our efforts in 2025 and beyond. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = I appreciate everything you’re doing to stop partisan gerrymandering and ensure fair maps. name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
subject: Tackling a crisis of faith
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
It's time to end this unethical practice.
#
Here’s the situation: Members of Congress have access to sensitive, privileged information to be able to anticipate and legislate as part of their jobs.
Some use this sensitive information to make _huge_ profits from buying and trading individual stocks that they know will perform well. **Then this happens:**
Since before she was elected, **Alexandria has called for an end to this unethical practice**.
So last week — alongside Representatives Krishnamoorthi, Mills, and Fitzpatrick — Alexandria introduced the **Bipartisan Restoring Faith in Government Act** to ban Congressmembers and their dependents from doing just that.
We must do everything we can to restore the American people’s faith in our institutions. **That starts with making sure that no one can abuse their position in Congress to make huge profits from the stock market**.
[Despite the incoming Trump trifecta, Alexandria isn’t afraid to demand better from Members of both parties. If you can, will you make a $5 contribution to power her fight to push Congress forward? ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250114.BP0Qy3&refcode=em20250114-7911-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7911%2E2526796%2E3wbIaV)

name: JB Pritzker
subject: Let’s start 2025 off strong
disclaimer_text: Paid for by JB for Governor Email sent to:
body:
When we march forward, we do it together.
---
Hi there, As we look toward the year ahead of us, I'm filled with a deep sense of pride about everything we accomplished in 2024. We fought to get Illinois Democrats elected up and down the ballot in our state and secured huge victories across the board. Democrats defended every seat in the General Assembly, and through our state party, we engaged over 2 million voters, hosted hundreds of events, and worked to help our neighboring states too. **But our state's progress extends far beyond electoral victories. ** In 2024, I signed several pieces of legislation into law that will protect our communities, and I announced investments that will secure our future. First, we further cemented ourselves as a safe haven for reproductive rights. We extended SHIELD laws to prohibit state and local governments from invvestigation health care services that are legal in Illinois. We addressed maternal mortality rates among Black and brown women, and protected new mothers and their babies through the Birth Equity Initiative. Women across the country are looking to our state for care, and we are prepared to provide it. Next, we made Illinois a global leader in quantum technology development, and we're already creating jobs by doing it. These are just a few of the many ways that we're building an Illinois that future generations will be proud of. In 2025, I'm confident that we will continue the progress. **Now, we'll face challenges in the year ahead and it won't always be easy. But as Illinoisans, we are resillient. Even with all the hurdles that may be ahead, we will pick ourselves up, march forward, and help others along the way. ** We are, after all, **One Illinois**. Governor JB Pritzker

**Ohio has elected 6 Black members of Congress, and four of those were elected from OH-11 – the district Shontel Brown now represents.**

[**Before we share more about the history of OH-11, will you chip in $5 or more to support Shontel Brown’s campaign today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/100402118/522646136/-211760203?refcode=EM_F_250113legacy_N_SB_90DO_9_NG_N_L1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MmE0ZmI3Ni1jZmQyLWVmMTEtODhkMC0wMDIyNDgyYTlkOTIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ez_VAjon13-oy1Ug7kp5wj0o9nNQyUlY2ajUBHvYHGU=)

As the _Daily Kos_ recently reported, Ohio’s first Black Congressman was Louis Stokes. Congressman Stokes was a founding member of the Congressional Black Caucus and co-wrote the brief that led to the US Supreme Court ruling that created Ohio’s first majority Black district.

Congresswoman Stephanie Tubbs Jones was the first Black woman elected to the US Congress from Ohio. Congresswoman Marcia Fudge succeeded her until 2021 when she resigned to become Secretary of Housing and Urban Development.

Shontel was elected to finish Congresswoman Fudge’s term in 2021 and is now starting her second full term in Congress.

**In just a short amount of time, Shontel has sponsored 19 bills and co-sponsored nearly 700 bills.** Ten have been enacted, including the Emmett Till Antilynching Act – which defines lynching as a federal hate crime, increasing the maximum penalty to 30 years imprisonment for several hate crime offenses.

**The legacy of these groundbreaking leaders runs decades long, and Shontel is just getting started as she works to build on what they have started. From ensuring access to comprehensive and affordable healthcare to combating climate change that is wreaking havoc on our nation to preserving our democracy and more, Shontel is ready to fight for the future of America.**

[**Shontel is a proven leader who is ready to tackle the challenges that our nation is facing, but she cannot do it alone. ❌ Slashing Social Security and Medicare to the bone...
❌ Implementing a nationwide abortion ban...

body:
Several direct and damaging lines of inquiry from Democrats — especially those from VoteVets members — tell you all you need to know.
#
Peter, nothing we saw today should convince anyone that Pete Hegseth is the right person to lead the Department of Defense.
The softball questions Hegseth got from his buddies on the Republican side show us that they’re likely to railroad him through. But several direct and damaging lines of inquiry from Democrats — especially those from VoteVets members — tell you all you need to know.
Take Senator Duckworth, for example. Tammy Duckworth flew Black Hawks with the National Guard in Iraq. She lost both of her legs after she was shot down in combat. Today, she drilled into Hegseth for his opposition to women serving in combat roles. She challenged him to identify at least one international security agreement, and how many nations were members of ASEAN — just a small part of his potential portfolio as SECDEF.
**Hegseth could not do it.**
Or Senator Slotkin. Elissa Slotkin served three tours in Iraq with the CIA before serving in the State Department and Department of Defense. She pressed Hegseth on his commitment to the Constitution — and whether he would be willing to defy Trump should he issue any unlawful orders.
**Hegseth dodged.**
In an interview, Senator Mark Kelly, who flew 39 combat missions as a Naval Aviator in the Gulf War, put it best: “No job is more important to our national security than Secretary of Defense. Nothing I’ve seen about Pete Hegseth’s record indicates he’s qualified.”
It matters having the right people in the right jobs. We are all better off because Senators Duckworth, Slotkin, and Kelly serve in the U.S. Senate. **Pete Hegseth is in no way ready to serve as Secretary of Defense.** If he is confirmed it is not just our Troops that will be in harm’s way — every American will be less safe.
We’re going to do everything we can to prevent it, but the odds are against us. We need you with us.

| **Even in Abigail’s very last days in Congress, she was working tirelessly to get her Social Security Fairness Act across the finish line and onto President Biden’s desk.**

Abigail has led the Social Security Fairness Act since she first arrived on Capitol Hill, and it was in her final weeks in Congress that she and her Republican co-lead ushered the bill through the House of Representatives and the Senate and then to the President’s desk!

The Social Security Fairness Act repeals the Windfall Elimination Provision (WEP) and the Government Pension Offset (GPO). These two provisions have effectively stolen benefits from retired public servants – teachers, police officers, letter carriers, firefighters, and local, state, and federal employees of all stripes – for more than forty years.

Now that the Social Security Fairness Act is LAW, nearly 2.5 million Americans – _including more than 50,000 Virginians will finally receive their fully earned Social Security benefits._

Abigail has led the Social Security Fairness Act since she first arrived on Capitol Hill, and it was in her final weeks in Congress that she and her Republican co-lead ushered the bill through the House of Representatives and the Senate and then to the President’s desk! The Social Security Fairness Act repeals the Windfall Elimination Provision (WEP) and the Government Pension Offset (GPO). These two provisions have effectively stolen benefits from retired public servants – teachers, police officers, letter carriers, firefighters, and local, state, and federal employees of all stripes – for more than forty years. Now that the Social Security Fairness Act is LAW, nearly 2.5 million Americans – including more than 50,000 Virginians will finally receive their fully earned Social Security benefits. = Abigail’s career in Congress was characterized by getting things done and bringing people together on both sides of the aisle, which is exactly what she did to earn strong bipartisan support on her landmark bill. subject: Please let us explain why a donation to the DNC is so important today:

Derek, We know that many of you are tired, disappointed, and burnt out, and the last thing you thought you would be doing is making a contribution to the Democratic National Committee today. But today is the day we need Democrats to step up and chip in if you're in a place to do so. Let us explain why: Trump’s new Republican Congress has already been sworn in and is working on their harmful agenda. And next week, Trump will officially become president. We’re already seeing the chaos and consequences that come with Republicans being in power. While Trump is focused on renaming the Gulf of Mexico and threatening to invade Greenland, his allies are working on a bill to give tax cuts to the wealthiest 1 percent while working families foot the bill. It’s clear that we need — America needs — a strong and robust Democratic Party to fight back, organize, and stop the dangerous plans of a second Trump administration and an emboldened Republican Party under his control. We get that you may be tired or feeling tapped out. But we cannot sit back and let Trump take us backward. So we have to ask one more time: [**We're asking you, humbly, to make a contribution to the Democratic Party today. It can be $5, $50, or whatever you can afford.
